"""Dump all TabItem names on current Edge; force View; scroll overflow listing every MenuItem."""
from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import importlib.util
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import uiautomation as auto

sys.path.insert(0, r"E:/ManualQA-Agent/mcp")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mqa", r"E:/ManualQA-Agent/mcp/server.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
u = ctypes.windll.user32
CLIP = Path(r"C:/Users/ThejanaD/AppData/Local/Temp/mqa-clip.txt")
EDGE = 265988
AI = "https://uat.fusionx.biz/web/lending/cNwNb/account-management/inquiry?mode=account"
ACCOUNT = "0042250036"


def force_fg(hwnd: int = EDGE):
    fg = u.GetForegroundWindow()
    tid1 = u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(fg, None)
    tid2 = u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, None)
    u.AttachThreadInput(tid1, tid2, True)
    u.ShowWindow(hwnd, 3)
    u.SetForegroundWindow(hwnd)
    u.AttachThreadInput(tid1, tid2, False)
    time.sleep(0.35)


def paste(s: str):
    CLIP.write_text(s, encoding="utf-8")
    subprocess.run(
        [
            "powershell",
            "-NoProfile",
            "-Command",
            f"Set-Clipboard -Value (Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 '{CLIP}')",
        ],
        check=True,
    )


def goto(url: str, wait: float = 11):
    force_fg()
    for w in m.mqa_list_windows(40)["windows"]:
        t = (w.get("title") or "").lower()
        if "whatsapp" in t or "aitheja" in t:
            u.ShowWindow(int(w["hwnd"]), 6)
    paste(url)
    m.mqa_hotkey("alt+d")
    time.sleep(0.2)
    m.mqa_hotkey("ctrl+a")
    time.sleep(0.05)
    m.mqa_hotkey("ctrl+v")
    time.sleep(0.12)
    m.mqa_hotkey("enter")
    time.sleep(wait)
    m.mqa_click(900, 550)


def list_tabs():
    names = []
    # Find all TabItem via FindAll style walk limited
    root = auto.GetRootControl()
    stack = [root]
    n = 0
    while stack and n < 2500:
        node = stack.pop(0)
        n += 1
        try:
            if node.ControlTypeName == "TabItemControl":
                r = node.BoundingRectangle
                names.append((node.Name, r.left, r.top, r.right, r.bottom))
            # only descend into Edge-ish
            title = node.Name or ""
            ctype = node.ControlTypeName
            if n < 5 or "Edge" in title or "Chrome" in (node.ClassName or "") or ctype in (
                "PaneControl",
                "DocumentControl",
                "WindowControl",
                "GroupControl",
                "TabControl",
                "CustomControl",
            ):
                for ch in node.GetChildren():
                    stack.append(ch)
        except Exception:
            continue
    print("TABCOUNT", len(names), flush=True)
    for row in names:
        print("TAB", row, flush=True)
    return names


def main():
    goto(AI, 11)
    m.mqa_click(882, 435)
    time.sleep(0.2)
    paste(ACCOUNT)
    m.mqa_hotkey("ctrl+a")
    time.sleep(0.05)
    m.mqa_hotkey("ctrl+v")
    time.sleep(0.1)
    m.mqa_hotkey("enter")
    time.sleep(4)
    # Click account number hyperlink first
    link = auto.HyperlinkControl(searchDepth=22, Name=ACCOUNT)
    if link.Exists(1):
        r = link.BoundingRectangle
        print("acct link", r, flush=True)
        m.mqa_click((r.left + r.right) // 2, (r.top + r.bottom) // 2)
        time.sleep(5)
    else:
        # View hyperlink carefully — prefer HyperlinkControl
        v = auto.HyperlinkControl(searchDepth=22, Name="View")
        if v.Exists(1):
            r = v.BoundingRectangle
            print("View link", r, flush=True)
            m.mqa_click((r.left + r.right) // 2, (r.top + r.bottom) // 2)
            time.sleep(5)
    p = m.mqa_capture(label="opened-account", ocr=False)["path"]
    print("CAP", p, flush=True)
    tabs = list_tabs()
    # Open >> and collect menu item names while scrolling
    m.mqa_click(1860, 314)
    time.sleep(1)
    auto.MoveTo(1720, 480)
    seen = set()
    for i in range(30):
        # gather MenuItem / ListItem names
        for ctype in (auto.MenuItemControl, auto.ListItemControl, auto.TextControl):
            # use FindControl with depth - iterate children of popup hard; use Tree walker from cursor parent
            pass
        auto.WheelDown(4)
        time.sleep(0.12)
        if i % 3 == 2:
            # snapshot OCR-less capture
            m.mqa_capture(label=f"ov-{i}", ocr=False)
    # After scroll try Select pattern on Receipt Details TabItem
    for nm in tabs:
        if nm[0] and "Receipt" in (nm[0] or ""):
            print("HAS RECEIPT TAB", nm, flush=True)
            t = auto.TabItemControl(searchDepth=26, Name=nm[0])
            if t.Exists(1):
                try:
                    t.GetSelectionItemPattern().Select()
                except Exception:
                    t.Click()
                time.sleep(4)
                print("CAP", m.mqa_capture(label="RECEIPT-TAB-SELECTED", ocr=False)["path"], flush=True)
    # Final dump of any control with Receipt in name near top
    stack = [auto.GetRootControl()]
    n = 0
    while stack and n < 3000:
        node = stack.pop()
        n += 1
        try:
            name = node.Name or ""
            if "Receipt" in name:
                r = node.BoundingRectangle
                print(
                    "RECEIPTCTL",
                    repr(name),
                    node.ControlTypeName,
                    (r.left, r.top, r.right, r.bottom),
                    flush=True,
                )
            if n < 2000:
                for ch in node.GetChildren():
                    stack.append(ch)
        except Exception:
            continue
    print("DONE", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

RR = "https://uat.fusionx.biz/web/lending/cNwNb/transaction-management/receipt-reallocation"
LOAN = "LNLOAN00110000348ILON2607"
PROOF = Path(r"C:/Users/ThejanaD/AppData/Local/Temp/mqa-proof-PF59194")
PROOF.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def force() -> int:
    for w in m.mqa_list_windows(80)["windows"]:
        t = (w.get("title") or "").lower()
        if any(x in t for x in ("whatsapp", "aitheja", "downloads", "telegram", "youtube")):
            try:
                u.ShowWindow(int(w["hwnd"]), 6)
            except Exception:
                pass
    hwnd = None
    for w in m.mqa_list_windows(80)["windows"]:
        t = w.get("title") or ""
        if "FusionX" in t and "Edge" in t:
            hwnd = int(w["hwnd"])
            break
    if not hwnd:
        raise RuntimeError("no FusionX")
    fg = u.GetForegroundWindow()

    u.ShowWindow(hwnd, 3)
    u.SetForegroundWindow(hwnd)
    u.AttachThreadInput(t1, t2, False)
    time.sleep(0.4)
    return hwnd


def paste(s: str):

    subprocess.run(
        [
            "powershell",
            "-NoProfile",
            "-Command",
            f"Set-Clipboard -Value (Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 '{CLIP}')",

        check=True,
    )


def goto(url: str, wait: float = 12):

def cap(label: str) -> str:

def click_name(name: str, min_top: int = 200, min_left: int = 400) -> bool:
    force()
    for ctype in (
        auto.RadioButtonControl,
        auto.HyperlinkControl,
        auto.ButtonControl,
        auto.TabItemControl,
        auto.TextControl,
    ):
        c = ctype(searchDepth=18, Name=name)
        if not c.Exists(0.5):
            continue
        r = c.BoundingRectangle
        if not (min_left < r.left < 1900 and min_top < r.top < 1050):
            continue
        if (r.right - r.left) < 4:
            continue
        print("CLICK", name, r, flush=True)
        m.mqa_click((r.left + r.right) // 2, (r.top + r.bottom) // 2)
        time.sleep(2.2)
        return True
    return False


def has_form_signal() -> bool:
    for nm in ("Internal", "External", "Enter value to start search"):
        for ctype in (auto.RadioButtonControl, auto.EditControl, auto.TextControl):
            c = ctype(searchDepth=16, Name=nm)
            if c.Exists(0.35):
                r = c.BoundingRectangle
                if 300 < r.left < 1800 and 200 < r.top < 900:
                    print("SIGNAL", nm, r, flush=True)
                    return True
    return False

    cap("R2-list")

        # URL may have changed; also Back link means we might be on empty create

        goto(RR + "/create", 10)
        force()
        m.mqa_hotkey("ctrl+r")
        time.sleep(10)
        force()
        cap("R2-create-refresh")
        if not has_form_signal():
            m.mqa_click(528, 370)  # Internal fallback
            time.sleep(2)

    cap("R2-form")
    if not click_name("Internal", 250, 400):
        m.mqa_click(528, 370)
        time.sleep(1.5)
    cap("R2-internal")

    e = auto.EditControl(searchDepth=18, Name="Enter value to start search")
    if e.Exists(2):
        e.Click()
        time.sleep(0.25)
        try:
            e.GetValuePattern().SetValue(LOAN)
        except Exception:
            auto.SendKeys("{Ctrl}a")
            auto.SendKeys(LOAN, waitTime=0.02)
        m.mqa_hotkey("enter")
        time.sleep(5)
    else:
        # click search box region then paste
        m.mqa_click(700, 520)
        time.sleep(0.3)
        paste(LOAN)
        m.mqa_hotkey("ctrl+v")
        time.sleep(0.2)
        m.mqa_hotkey("enter")
        time.sleep(5)
    cap("R2-loan")

    for i in range(4):
        if click_name("Select", 450, 1450):
            time.sleep(5)
        else:
            for xy in ((1702, 728), (1680, 700), (1720, 750), (1650, 680)):

                m.mqa_click(*xy)

                if e2.Exists(0.4):
                    print("receipt search after", xy, flush=True)
                    break
        cap(f"R2-sel-{i}")
        e2 = auto.EditControl(searchDepth=16, Name="Enter Receipt Number to Search")
        if e2.Exists(0.5):
            print("receipt search OK", e2.BoundingRectangle, flush=True)
        save = auto.ButtonControl(searchDepth=14, Name="Save")
        if save.Exists(0.4):
            r = save.BoundingRectangle
            print("Save", r, flush=True)
            if 400 < r.left < 1900 and r.top > 200:
                cap("R2-save-visible")
                # do not force-enable; click once to observe block/toast
                m.mqa_click((r.left + r.right) // 2, (r.top + r.bottom) // 2)
                time.sleep(2.5)
                cap("R2-save-after")
                break
    else:
        cap("R2-sel-exhausted")

    # Pending Actions probe (observe only)
    goto(RR, 11)
    if not click_name("Pending Requests", 280, 500):
        m.mqa_click(820, 329)
        time.sleep(2)
    cap("R2-pending")
    for xy in ((1725, 448), (1700, 448), (1750, 470), (1680, 448)):
        force()
        m.mqa_click(*xy)
        time.sleep(3.5)
        hit = False
        for nm in ("Approve", "Reject", "Return"):
            b = auto.ButtonControl(searchDepth=14, Name=nm)
            if b.Exists(0.3):
                r = b.BoundingRectangle
                if 400 < r.left < 1900:
                    print("FOUND", nm, r, flush=True)
                    hit = True
        if hit:
            cap("R2-pending-actions")
            break
        cap(f"R2-pend-{xy[0]}-{xy[1]}")
    print("DONE", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Open AuNEXO login and start MethmiB via AzureAd (or username form). Never print password."""
from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import importlib.util
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import uiautomation as auto

sys.path.insert(0, r"E:/ManualQA-Agent/mcp")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mqa", r"E:/ManualQA-Agent/mcp/server.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
u = ctypes.windll.user32
CLIP = Path(r"C:/Users/ThejanaD/AppData/Local/Temp/mqa-clip.txt")
PROOF = Path(r"C:/Users/ThejanaD/AppData/Local/Temp/mqa-proof-PF59194")
PROOF.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
LOGIN = (
    "https://fusionx-uat.aunex0.com/Account/Login"
    "?ReturnUrl=%2Fconnect%2Fauthorize%2Fcallback%3Fclient_id%3DcNwNb"
)
CREDS = json.loads(Path(r"E:/ManualQA-Agent/secrets/tmp-checker-creds.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
EMAIL = CREDS["email"]
PASSWORD = CREDS["password"]


def force_edge() -> int:
    hwnd = None
    for w in m.mqa_list_windows(80)["windows"]:
        t = w.get("title") or ""
        if "Edge" in t and ("Aunex" in t or "Sign in" in t or "FusionX" in t or "Microsoft" in t):
            hwnd = int(w["hwnd"])
            if "Profile 2" in t or "Person 1" in t or "Work" in t:
                break
    if not hwnd:
        for w in m.mqa_list_windows(80)["windows"]:
            if "Edge" in (w.get("title") or ""):
                hwnd = int(w["hwnd"])
                break
    if not hwnd:
        raise RuntimeError("no Edge")
    fg = u.GetForegroundWindow()
    t1 = u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(fg, None)
    t2 = u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, None)
    u.AttachThreadInput(t1, t2, True)
    u.ShowWindow(hwnd, 3)
    u.SetForegroundWindow(hwnd)
    u.AttachThreadInput(t1, t2, False)
    time.sleep(0.4)
    return hwnd


def paste(s: str) -> None:
    CLIP.write_text(s, encoding="utf-8")
    cmd = f"Set-Clipboard -Value (Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 '{CLIP}')"
    subprocess.run(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command", cmd], check=True)


def cap(label: str) -> str:
    force_edge()
    p = m.mqa_capture(label=label, ocr=False)["path"]
    shutil.copy2(p, PROOF / f"{label}.png")
    print("CAP", label, flush=True)
    return p


def goto(url: str, wait: float = 8) -> None:
    force_edge()
    paste(url)
    m.mqa_hotkey("alt+d")
    time.sleep(0.25)
    m.mqa_hotkey("ctrl+a")
    time.sleep(0.05)
    m.mqa_hotkey("ctrl+v")
    time.sleep(0.12)
    m.mqa_hotkey("enter")
    time.sleep(wait)
    force_edge()


def click_uia_name(name: str) -> bool:
    force_edge()
    for ctype in (auto.ButtonControl, auto.HyperlinkControl, auto.TextControl, auto.ListItemControl):
        c = ctype(searchDepth=22, Name=name)
        if not c.Exists(0.8):
            continue
        r = c.BoundingRectangle
        if r.left <= 0 or (r.right - r.left) < 4:
            continue
        print("UIA", name, r.left, r.top, r.right, r.bottom, flush=True)
        m.mqa_click((r.left + r.right) // 2, (r.top + r.bottom) // 2)
        time.sleep(3)
        return True
    return False


def main() -> None:
    goto(LOGIN, 9)
    cap("M1-login")
    # Prefer AzureAd
    if not click_uia_name("Continue with AzureAd"):
        # pixel fallbacks: AzureAd is SECOND SSO button (below Google)
        for xy in ((960, 560), (960, 545), (850, 555), (1000, 555), (960, 575)):
            force_edge()
            print("TRY", xy, flush=True)
            m.mqa_click(*xy)
            time.sleep(4)
            force_edge()
            titles = " | ".join((w.get("title") or "")[:40] for w in m.mqa_list_windows(40)["windows"][:8])
            print("TITLES", titles.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode(), flush=True)
            if "login.microsoftonline" in titles.lower() or "Pick an account" in titles or "Sign in" in titles:
                if "Google" not in titles:
                    break
            # if still Aunex0 login, continue
    cap("M1-after-azure-click")

    # If Microsoft picker: click MethmiB / use another account
    for nm in (
        "MethmiB@lolctech.com",
        "Methmi B",
        "MethmiB",
        "Use another account",
        "Use another account.",
    ):
        if click_uia_name(nm):
            break

    cap("M1-picker")
    # If email field: paste MethmiB email
    e = auto.EditControl(searchDepth=18, Name="Email, phone, or Skype")
    if not e.Exists(0.5):
        e = auto.EditControl(searchDepth=18, Name="Enter your email, phone, or Skype.")
    if e.Exists(0.5):
        e.Click()
        time.sleep(0.2)
        paste(EMAIL)
        m.mqa_hotkey("ctrl+a")
        m.mqa_hotkey("ctrl+v")
        time.sleep(0.2)
        m.mqa_hotkey("enter")
        time.sleep(3)
        cap("M1-email")

    # Password field if present (do not log value)
    p = auto.EditControl(searchDepth=18, Name="Password")
    if p.Exists(1.0):
        p.Click()
        time.sleep(0.2)
        paste(PASSWORD)
        m.mqa_hotkey("ctrl+a")
        m.mqa_hotkey("ctrl+v")
        time.sleep(0.2)
        m.mqa_hotkey("enter")
        time.sleep(4)
        cap("M1-after-password")

    print("EMAIL_USED", EMAIL, flush=True)
    print("DONE_OPEN_HUMAN_GATE_IF_MFA", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from openpyxl import Workbook

        img_by_row[row] = img
    except Exception as e:
        print('img map err', e)

print('imgs mapped', len(img_by_row))

# New workbook

| Layer | What |
|--------|------|
| **Orchestrator** | ManualQA Company (`mqa_boot` / roles) + AgentsOrchestrator doctrine — phase gates, no skip |
| **Headed UI** | ManualQA / humanize — screenshot → decide → mouse/keyboard → wait frame |

"""Agency-agents mesh — index and dispatch specialist roles into LIQA runs."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from paths import AGENCY_ROOT, WORKSPACE

# Core QA cell always available even if agency-agents path missing
CORE_SPECIALISTS = [
    "agents-orchestrator",
    "evidence-collector",
    "reality-checker",
    "senior-project-manager",
    "multi-agent-systems-architect",
    "test-results-analyzer",
    "test-automation-engineer",
    "product-manager",
    "workflow-architect",
    "code-reviewer",
    "technical-writer",
    "api-tester",
    "accessibility-auditor",
    "performance-benchmarker",
    "incident-responder",
]


def _agents_dir() -> Path:
    rules = AGENCY_ROOT / ".cursor" / "rules"
    if rules.is_dir():
        return rules
    return AGENCY_ROOT


def list_specialists(limit: int = 300) -> dict[str, Any]:
    root = _agents_dir()
    items: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    if root.is_dir():
        for p in sorted(root.glob("*.mdc")):
            name = p.stem
            desc = ""
            try:
                text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
                m = re.search(r"(?m)^description:\s*(.+)$", text)
                if m:
                    desc = m.group(1).strip().strip("'\"")
                else:
                    # first non-empty non-frontmatter line
                    for line in text.splitlines():
                        s = line.strip()
                        if s and not s.startswith("---") and not s.startswith("description"):
                            desc = s[:240]
                            break
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                desc = ""
            items.append({"id": name, "path": str(p), "description": desc})
            if len(items) >= limit:
                break
    # ensure core names present
    have = {i["id"] for i in items}
    for c in CORE_SPECIALISTS:
        if c not in have:
            items.append({"id": c, "path": "", "description": "core LIQA specialist", "core": True})
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "agency_root": str(AGENCY_ROOT),
        "count": len(items),
        "specialists": items,
        "core": CORE_SPECIALISTS,
    }


def _assign_log() -> Path:
    d = WORKSPACE / "agents" / "mesh"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d / "assignments.jsonl"


def dispatch(specialist_id: str, workstream: str, brief: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    catalog = list_specialists()
    match = next((s for s in catalog["specialists"] if s["id"] == specialist_id), None)
    if match is None:
        # fuzzy contains
        match = next((s for s in catalog["specialists"] if specialist_id in s["id"]), None)
    if match is None:
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "error": f"specialist not found: {specialist_id}",
            "hint": "Call liqa_agency_list",
        }
    row = {
        "ts": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "specialist": match["id"],
        "workstream": workstream,
        "brief": brief,
        "path": match.get("path", ""),
    }
    with _assign_log().open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    # also write role file for orchestrator visibility
    role_dir = WORKSPACE / "agents" / "mesh" / match["id"]
    role_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (role_dir / "latest.json").write_text(json.dumps(row, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "assigned": row,
        "instruction": (
            f"Operate as agency specialist '{match['id']}' for workstream '{workstream}'. "
            f"Brief: {brief}. Stay inside LIQA ISTQB gates; return evidence paths only."
        ),
    }


def mesh_status() -> dict[str, Any]:
    log = _assign_log()
    recent: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    if log.exists():
        lines = log.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[-40:]
        for line in lines:
            try:
                recent.append(json.loads(line))
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
    catalog = list_specialists()
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "specialist_count": catalog["count"],
        "assignments_recent": recent,
        "agency_root": catalog["agency_root"],
        "core": CORE_SPECIALISTS,
    }

"""Per-round learner — harvest what sped QA up and propose next-run shortcuts."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from paths import WORKSPACE, KNOWLEDGE_ROOT, REPO_ROOT


def _store() -> Path:
    d = WORKSPACE / "learner"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d / "speed-log.jsonl"


def _playbook() -> Path:
    d = KNOWLEDGE_ROOT
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d / "SPEED-PLAYBOOK.md"


def record(
    task_key: str,
    notes: str,
    what_worked: str = "",
    what_slowed: str = "",
    seconds_saved_estimate: int = 0,
    techniques: list[str] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = {
        "ts": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "task_key": task_key,
        "notes": notes,
        "what_worked": what_worked,
        "what_slowed": what_slowed,
        "seconds_saved_estimate": int(seconds_saved_estimate or 0),
        "techniques": techniques or [],
    }
    with _store().open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    # append playbook bullets
    pb = _playbook()
    bullets = []
    if what_worked.strip():
        bullets.append(f"- WORKED ({task_key}): {what_worked.strip()}")
    if what_slowed.strip():
        bullets.append(f"- AVOID ({task_key}): {what_slowed.strip()}")
    for t in techniques or []:
        if t.strip():
            bullets.append(f"- TECHNIQUE ({task_key}): {t.strip()}")
    if bullets:
        header = f"\n## Round {datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')}\n"
        if not pb.exists():
            pb.write_text(
                "# LIQA Speed Playbook\n\nLearned shortcuts from real headed QA rounds.\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
        with pb.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(header)
            f.write("\n".join(bullets) + "\n")
    return {"ok": True, "recorded": row, "playbook": str(pb)}


def suggest(task_key: str = "", limit: int = 12) -> dict[str, Any]:
    store = _store()
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    if store.exists():
        for line in store.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            try:
                rows.append(json.loads(line))
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
    if task_key:
        preferred = [r for r in rows if r.get("task_key") == task_key]
        others = [r for r in rows if r.get("task_key") != task_key]
        rows = preferred + others
    tips = []
    for r in reversed(rows[-limit:]):
        if r.get("what_worked"):
            tips.append({"type": "reuse", "text": r["what_worked"], "from": r.get("task_key")})
        if r.get("what_slowed"):
            tips.append({"type": "avoid", "text": r["what_slowed"], "from": r.get("task_key")})
        for t in r.get("techniques") or []:
            tips.append({"type": "technique", "text": t, "from": r.get("task_key")})
    # built-in speed defaults from PF-55248 / PF-59194 success
    defaults = [
        {"type": "default", "text": "Prefer Playwright CDP on live Edge session over raw pyautogui for SPA forms."},
        {"type": "default", "text": "Minimize Excel before every capture — it steals focus and poisons proof."},
        {"type": "default", "text": "Human Gate only for Azure AD / OTP; do not pause for ordinary clicks."},
        {"type": "default", "text": "Build Book1 from headed proof folder only; never invent screenshots."},
        {"type": "default", "text": "Pull migrated account numbers from existing Jira/Xray evidence before blocking."},
    ]
    playbook_exists = _playbook().exists()
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "task_key": task_key,
        "tips": (tips + defaults)[: limit + len(defaults)],
        "rounds_logged": len(rows),
        "playbook": str(_playbook()) if playbook_exists else None,
        "message": "Apply tips at planning + first headed navigation to uplift speed.",
    }


def learn_cycle(notes: str = "", task_key: str = "") -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Called at ISTQB completion — always write a speed round."""
    # pull last trajectory hint if worker left one
    traj = REPO_ROOT / "trajectories"
    last_note = notes
    if traj.is_dir():
        files = sorted(traj.glob("*.json"), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)
        if files:
            try:
                data = json.loads(files[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                last_note = notes or json.dumps(data)[:500]
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
    rec = record(
        task_key=task_key or "general",
        notes=last_note or "learn_cycle",
        what_worked="Completed learn_cycle; refresh SPEED-PLAYBOOK before next task.",
        what_slowed="",
        techniques=["liqa_learn_speed before nav", "liqa_agency_dispatch for parallel intake"],
    )
    sug = suggest(task_key=task_key)
    return {"ok": True, "recorded": rec, "suggest": sug}

**Honest answer: not fully — not yet. You can replace a large share of the *execution* work, not the whole QA team.**

### What you *can* hand to agents (real, today)
For products like FusionX UAT, with good access and gold patterns (PF-55248 level):

- Pull Jira / stories / existing tests  
- Experience-map the UI headed  
- Write and run a lot of scripted + exploratory checks  
- Capture proof, build Book1 SHARE-style Excel  
- Draft bugs, run honesty loops, learn speed next round  

That is **real Manual QA clone work**. On a smooth run, one strong agent cell can outperform a slow human on volume and consistency of evidence.

### What you *cannot* honestly claim as full team replacement
Agents still stop or degrade on:

| Blocker | Why a human (or Human Gate) stays |
|--------|-----------------------------------|
| OTP / MFA / CAPTCHA | Must not invent codes — law + reality |
| Broken SSO / splash-only login | No reliable DOM; needs a person |
| Missing business data (migrated accounts, etc.) | Not a product bug; needs ops/BA |
| True product judgment / release sign-off | Regulated banking still wants a named human |
| Brand-new apps with no map/gold | Agents are weaker until the first good trajectory exists |
| Flaky desktop (Excel steal focus, locked session) | Environment ownership, not “AI IQ” |

So: **full QA flow handover to agents = mostly yes for *routine headed Manual QA*.**  
**Fully replace the QA team = no**, if “replace” means zero humans, zero gates, and full accountability.

### Straight % (practical, not marketing)
For a mature, mapped product with vault creds and clear stories:

- **~60–80%** of day-to-day Manual QA *execution* can sit on LIQA-class agents  
- **~20–40%** stays human: access, MFA, data, unclear UI, release ownership, stakeholder fights  

That matches what we actually hit: strong Book1 / headed proof when unblocked; stop-and-ask when SSO, checker, or account numbers were missing.

### Bottom line
- **Idea is right** for “agents own the QA *flow*.”  
- **Idea is oversold** if it means “fire the QA team tomorrow and never ask a human.”  

Best honest product stance for LIQA:  
**Agent-primary Manual QA company + Human Gate for real blockers + human sign-off for release** — not “zero QA humans.”

# LIQA Industry Product — 2 QA humans + agent execution

## Product statement

**LIQA Industry** is the deployable form of Manual QA execution:

- **LIQA Workers** run almost all headed QA execution
- **2 QA humans** own gates, data unblock, and release sign-off
- Remaining staff move off click-level QA

This is **not** “put Cursor on a laptop and hope.”  
Industry grade = **Control plane + headed Worker appliances + Human Gate inbox**.

---

## Best suitable method (honest)

| Option | Fit | Verdict |
|--------|-----|---------|
| **Dedicated Windows Worker VM / VDI** (Azure VM, Hyper-V, VMware, AVD) | Interactive desktop, autologon, never-lock, outbound-only to Control | **Primary — industry default** |
| Physical Windows QA PCs | Same as VM, stronger for GPU/OCR | OK for on-prem banks |
| Linux Docker / k8s headless Chrome | No real desktop Hands | **Reject for Manual QA SKU** |
| Cursor Cloud Agent alone | Cannot click customer Windows UAT | Authoring only, not execution SKU |
| One shared RDP session for many jobs | Focus fights, proof pollution | Avoid; 1 job ↔ 1 worker session |

**Recommendation:**  
1–N **Windows Worker VMs** inside the customer network (or VDI), plus **1 Control** (private VPC or on-prem).  
Cursor MCP (`liqa`) stays for **agent authors / platform team** — production jobs queue through Control.

```
 Jira / backlog
        │
        ▼
 ┌─────────────────────┐
 │  LIQA Control       │  ← 2 QA humans live here (gates + sign-off UI)
 │  jobs · gates ·     │
 │  audit · Book1 meta │
 └─────────┬───────────┘
           │ worker polls OUTBOUND (no inbound bank hole)
           ▼
 ┌─────────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────────┐
 │ Worker VM A         │     │ Worker VM B         │  … scale out
 │ headed Edge/Chrome  │     │ headed Edge/Chrome  │
 │ Eyes/Brain/Hands    │     │ Eyes/Brain/Hands    │
 │ local vault         │     │ local vault         │
 └─────────┬───────────┘     └─────────┬───────────┘
           └──────────┬────────────────┘
                      ▼
                 Customer UAT
```

---

## SKUs

| SKU | Who | What ships |
|-----|-----|------------|
| **LIQA Bank** | Regulated | Workers on-prem/VDI; pixels stay on worker; local LLM; Control private |
| **LIQA Hybrid** | Mid-market | Workers in customer VNet; Control managed; labels only leave worker |
| **LIQA Studio** | Platform team | Cursor MCP + gold packs + handover zip (dev/authoring) |

Industry “replace 18 of 20 clickers” = **Bank or Hybrid** + Studio for the platform owners.

---

## Capacity planning (starting point)

| Workers (headed VMs) | Rough concurrent stories | Human gate load (2 QA) |
|----------------------|--------------------------|-------------------------|
| 1 | 1 active headed run | Light |
| 2–3 | Parallel epics / tenants | Normal for 2 seniors |
| 5+ | Multi-product factory | Need clear on-call rota for the 2 |

Rule: **one headed job per worker desktop session**.

---

## Non-negotiables (industry)

1. Worker `/health` fails if Session 0 / locked / LogonUI  
2. Secrets never in git; worker-local vault or HSM/Key Vault inject at boot  
3. Human Gate for OTP/MFA — alert the 2 QA (Teams/email/Control inbox)  
4. Book1 SHARE validators before sign-off  
5. Audit log on job create / gate resolve / sign-off  
6. Outbound-only worker connectivity where bank policy requires it  

---

## Deploy docs

- Ops model for the 2 humans: `docs/OPS-MODEL-2QA.md`
- Worker VM blueprint: `docs/DEPLOY-WORKER-VM.md`
- Architecture (market patterns): `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- Quality bar: `docs/QUALITY-CONTRACT.md`

## Bootstrap

```powershell
# On Control host
powershell -File scripts\bootstrap-control.ps1

# On each Worker VM (interactive user session)
powershell -File scripts\bootstrap-worker-vm.ps1
powershell -File scripts\verify-install.ps1
powershell -File scripts\register-logon-task.ps1
```

# Ops model — 2 QA humans + LIQA execution

## Roles

### QA Gate Lead (Human 1) — primary on-call
- Owns Human Gate inbox (OTP / MFA / unclear UI)
- Unblocks vault / SSO / checker accounts
- First-line sign-off on Book1 for normal stories

### QA Sign-off Lead (Human 2) — quality owner
- Spot-checks agent proofs (sample %)
- Approves REAL_BUG vs BLOCKED calls on disputes
- Release / Done transition in Jira after validators pass
- Escalates product defects to engineering

Both may rotate weekly. Never leave gates with nobody watching.

---

## Daily loop

```
08:30  Open Control UI → Workers headed? Gates empty?
09:00  Queue / confirm Jira-assigned KEYs as LIQA jobs
       (agents/Workers execute — humans do not click stories)
…      Slack/Teams: gate alerts only
Anytime Resolve gate (enter OTP / complete SSO / supply account #)
16:00  Review Book1 validate + honesty for finished jobs
16:30  Sign-off → Jira Done / bug push
17:00  Learner notes (what slowed workers today)
```

Humans **do not** re-run the full Manual QA walk unless spot-check fails.

---

## When a human must act (only these)

| Event | Action |
|-------|--------|
| Gate: OTP / MFA | Enter code in Control / on Worker live view |
| Gate: SSO splash | Complete login once; leave session for worker |
| Gate: missing data | Fetch account/receipt from Jira/ops; resume job |
| Worker health red | Unlock VM / fix autologon / restart headed session |
| Validator fail | Reject sign-off; send job back to worker |
| Suspected fantasy PASS | Re-run honesty / headed sample |

Everything else = LIQA execution.

---

## Control UI focus (2-human console)

Must show at all times:

1. **Workers** — headed ready / locked / Session 0  
2. **Gates** — waiting human (age, story, worker)  
3. **Jobs** — queued / running / needs_signoff / done  
4. **Sign-off** — Book1 path + validate result  
5. **Audit** — who resolved which gate  

API surface:

- `GET /v1/ops/summary` — single pane for the 2  
- `POST /v1/gates/{id}/resolve` — human completed gate  
- `POST /v1/jobs/{id}/signoff` — human accepts Done  

---

## SLAs (suggested)

| Item | Target |
|------|--------|
| Gate acknowledgment | < 15 min business hours |
| Gate resolve (OTP) | < 5 min after SMS received |
| Sign-off after Book1 green | < 1 business day |
| Worker red health | < 30 min restore |

---

## Anti-patterns (breaks the 2-person model)

- Humans still clicking every FusionX path “just to be sure”  
- Sharing one RDP desktop across parallel jobs  
- Ignoring gates overnight with jobs stuck  
- Signing off without `book1_validate`  
- Storing passwords in chat / tickets  

---

## Success metric

After 30 days:

- ≥ 80% of story execution hours on Workers  
- ≤ 2 FTE on QA gates/sign-off  
- Gate volume trending down (SSO sessions sticky, data packs ready)  
- Book1 SHARE pass rate ≥ 95% on first sign-off attempt

# Deploy LIQA Worker VM (industry default)

## Why a VM / VDI (not a random laptop)

Manual QA Hands need a **stable interactive Windows session**:

- Autologon user (not Session 0 service)
- Screen never locks during business hours
- Edge/Chrome installed
- Outbound HTTPS to Control only (bank-friendly)
- Local vault for maker/checker

Laptop Cursor MCP is for **authors**. Production execution = **Worker VM**.

---

## Minimum VM spec

| Resource | Minimum | Recommended |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| OS | Windows 10/11 Pro or Windows Server with Desktop Experience | Win11 Enterprise / AVD |
| vCPU | 4 | 8 |
| RAM | 16 GB | 32 GB |
| Disk | 128 GB SSD | 256 GB (proofs) |
| Display | 1920×1080 virtual display | Dual if OCR-heavy |
| Network | Outbound 443 to Control + UAT | No inbound from internet |

Cloud examples: Azure `D4s_v5` / `D8s_v5`, or AVD personal host pool.

---

## One-time bootstrap (on the VM)

1. Create local service account `liqa-worker` (or domain) with autologon  
2. Disable lock screen / set power to never sleep when plugged in  
3. Install Python 3.11+, Edge, Git  
4. Clone / unzip LIQA to `C:\LIQA` (or `D:\LIQA`)  
5. Copy `.env` + `secrets\tmp-creds.json` (from vault inject — not email)  
6. Set `LIQA_CONTROL_URL=https://control.internal/...`  
7. Run:

```powershell
cd C:\LIQA
powershell -File scripts\bootstrap-worker-vm.ps1
powershell -File scripts\verify-install.ps1
powershell -File scripts\register-logon-task.ps1
```

8. Reboot into autologon; confirm `GET http://127.0.0.1:8787/health` → headed ok  
9. Worker heartbeats to Control

---

## Hardening

- BitLocker on disk  
- Creds only in DPAPI / Windows Credential Manager / Key Vault agent  
- No inbound RDP from internet (jump host / Bastion only for the 2 QA)  
- Capture retention policy (auto-prune proofs older than N days)  
- Separate Worker per tenant if bank isolation requires it  

---

## Control placement

| Mode | Control runs | Workers run |
|------|--------------|-------------|
| Bank | On-prem VM / private AKS+Windows jump | Same DC / VDI |
| Hybrid | Customer VNet appliance | Customer VNet |
| Studio-only | Dev laptop | Dev laptop (non-prod) |

Workers **poll outbound**; do not open inbound ports on the bank firewall for Control→Worker if policy forbids it.

---

## Scale-out

- Clone golden Worker image (Sysprep carefully — keep autologon recipe)  
- Register unique `LIQA_WORKER_ID` per VM  
- Control assigns jobs only to `headed: true` workers  
- Never two headed jobs on one desktop  

---

## Acceptance before go-live

- [ ] `verify-install.ps1` green  
- [ ] Health red when locked (prove fail-closed)  
- [ ] Queue job from Control → Worker executes headed  
- [ ] Force a Human Gate → appears in Control → 2QA resolve → job resumes  
- [ ] Book1 validate + sign-off path exercised once  
- [ ] Audit entries present  

See `docs/INDUSTRY-PRODUCT.md` and `docs/OPS-MODEL-2QA.md`.

"""Industry ops model APIs — 2QA console contracts."""
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CTRL = ROOT / "apps" / "control" / "server.py"


def _load_control():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("liqa_control", CTRL)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    assert spec.loader
    # Don't run main
    sys.modules["liqa_control"] = mod
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


def test_industry_docs_exist():
    for rel in (
        "docs/INDUSTRY-PRODUCT.md",
        "docs/OPS-MODEL-2QA.md",
        "docs/DEPLOY-WORKER-VM.md",
        "docs/ARCHITECTURE.md",
    ):
        assert (ROOT / rel).exists(), rel


def test_bootstrap_scripts_exist():
    assert (ROOT / "scripts" / "bootstrap-control.ps1").exists()
    assert (ROOT / "scripts" / "bootstrap-worker-vm.ps1").exists()
    assert (ROOT / "scripts" / "register-logon-task.ps1").exists()
    assert (ROOT / "scripts" / "verify-install.ps1").exists()


def test_control_has_2qa_apis():
    src = CTRL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "/v1/ops/summary" in src
    assert "/resolve" in src
    assert "/signoff" in src
    assert "needs_signoff" in src
    assert "2 QA" in src or "2QA" in src


def test_ops_summary_logic_shapes():
    # Light unit: ensure DATA folders and helper list work when imported
    mod = _load_control()
    assert hasattr(mod, "DATA")
    for sub in ("jobs", "workers", "gates", "audit"):
        assert (mod.DATA / sub).exists() or True  # mkdir on import
    # Write a fake gate + job and ensure list returns dicts
    g = {"id": "testgate", "status": "waiting_human"}
    (mod.DATA / "gates" / "testgate.json").write_text(json.dumps(g), encoding="utf-8")
    items = mod._list("gates")
    assert any(x.get("id") == "testgate" for x in items)

$excludeDirs = @(

)
$excludeFiles = @('.env', 'tmp-creds.json', 'session.json')

function ShouldSkip([string]$full) {
  $rel = $full.Substring($Root.Length).TrimStart('\','/')
  foreach ($d in $excludeDirs) {
    if ($rel -like "$d*") { return $true }
  }
  $name = Split-Path $full -Leaf
  if ($excludeFiles -contains $name) { return $true }
  if ($name -like '*.pyc') { return $true }
  return $false
}

Get-ChildItem $Root -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object {
  if (ShouldSkip $_.FullName) { return }
  $rel = $_.FullName.Substring($Root.Length).TrimStart('\','/')
  $dest = Join-Path $stage $rel
  $destParent = Split-Path $dest -Parent
  if (-not (Test-Path $destParent)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $destParent | Out-Null }
  Copy-Item $_.FullName $dest -Force
}

# Theja Manual QA Company (2026-09-13-company-final-v3)

You ARE **Manual QA Engineer (clone)** inside the merged company MCP — not a summarizer, not a pipeline runner.

## YouTube analogy (job definition)

You QA any product like a human Manual QA engineer:
1. Read what to test (assigned Jira / stories).
2. Write test cases from acceptance criteria + experience map.

"""Mandatory Jira full harvest gate for LIQA intake.

Before headed map / Book1 design, the agent MUST harvest from Atlassian:
- Assigned / clone KEY fields + comments
- Linked stories (Cloners, Relates, Tests)
- Feature / epic / parent issues
- ALL attachments (PDF, images, msg) into knowledgeBase/<KEY>/jira-attachments/
- Confluence pages linked from description when present

This module records a checklist; announce_planning_done / phase-1 complete
should not be treated as honest if harvest.ok is false.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from paths import WORKSPACE

REQUIRED_BUCKETS = (
    "issue_fields",
    "linked_issues",
    "feature_or_epic",
    "attachments",
    "existing_xray",
    "comments_or_description",
)


def _harvest_dir(task_key: str) -> Path:
    d = WORKSPACE / "knowledgeBase" / task_key / "jira-harvest"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def _attachments_dir(task_key: str) -> Path:
    d = WORKSPACE / "knowledgeBase" / task_key / "jira-attachments"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def harvest_status(task_key: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    path = _harvest_dir(task_key) / "HARVEST.json"
    if not path.exists():
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "task_key": task_key,
            "complete": False,
            "missing": list(REQUIRED_BUCKETS),
            "message": "No harvest yet. Call liqa_jira_harvest_record after Atlassian pull.",
            "path": str(path),
        }
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    missing = [b for b in REQUIRED_BUCKETS if not data.get("buckets", {}).get(b)]
    att_dir = _attachments_dir(task_key)
    files = sorted(p.name for p in att_dir.iterdir() if p.is_file()) if att_dir.exists() else []
    complete = len(missing) == 0 and (
        not data.get("attachments_expected") or len(files) >= int(data.get("attachments_expected") or 0)
    )
    # attachments bucket true + expected 0 is OK; if expected > 0 need files
    if data.get("buckets", {}).get("attachments") and int(data.get("attachments_expected") or 0) > 0:
        complete = complete and len(files) >= int(data["attachments_expected"])
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "task_key": task_key,
        "complete": complete and len(missing) == 0,
        "missing": missing,
        "attachments_on_disk": files,
        "attachments_expected": data.get("attachments_expected"),
        "sources": data.get("sources", []),
        "notes": data.get("notes", ""),
        "updated_at": data.get("updated_at"),
        "path": str(path),
        "law": "Do not start headed map until harvest.complete is true.",
    }


def record_harvest(
    task_key: str,
    *,
    sources: list[str] | None = None,
    buckets: dict[str, bool] | None = None,
    attachments_expected: int = 0,
    attachment_names: list[str] | None = None,
    notes: str = "",
    merge: bool = True,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    path = _harvest_dir(task_key) / "HARVEST.json"
    prev: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if merge and path.exists():
        prev = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    bucket_state = dict(prev.get("buckets") or {})
    for k in REQUIRED_BUCKETS:
        bucket_state.setdefault(k, False)
    if buckets:
        for k, v in buckets.items():
            if k in REQUIRED_BUCKETS:
                bucket_state[k] = bool(v)
    src = list(prev.get("sources") or [])
    for s in sources or []:
        if s and s not in src:
            src.append(s)
    names = list(prev.get("attachment_names") or [])
    for n in attachment_names or []:
        if n and n not in names:
            names.append(n)
    expected = max(int(prev.get("attachments_expected") or 0), int(attachments_expected or 0), len(names))
    payload = {
        "task_key": task_key,
        "buckets": bucket_state,
        "sources": src,
        "attachments_expected": expected,
        "attachment_names": names,
        "notes": notes or prev.get("notes", ""),
        "updated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "required_buckets": list(REQUIRED_BUCKETS),
    }
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    md = _harvest_dir(task_key) / "HARVEST.md"
    lines = [
        f"# Jira harvest — {task_key}",
        "",
        f"Updated: {payload['updated_at']}",
        "",
        "## Sources",
        *[f"- {s}" for s in src] or ["- (none)"],
        "",
        "## Buckets",
        *[f"- [{'x' if bucket_state[b] else ' '}] {b}" for b in REQUIRED_BUCKETS],
        "",
        f"Attachments expected: {expected}",
        f"Attachment names: {', '.join(names) if names else '(none)'}",
        "",
        notes,
        "",
        "## Law",
        "MUST pull assigned KEY + linked Cloners/Relates/Test + feature/epic/parent + ALL attachments",
        "into knowledgeBase/<KEY>/jira-attachments/ BEFORE headed map.",
    ]
    md.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    st = harvest_status(task_key)
    st["recorded"] = True
    st["md"] = str(md)
    return st


def checklist_for_agent() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "mandatory_before_headed_map": [
            "getJiraIssue(*all) for assigned/clone KEY",
            "Follow issuelinks: Cloners, Relates, Test (is tested by / tests)",
            "Open feature/epic/parent (e.g. PF-50130) even if attachments are empty on QA clone",
            "Download EVERY attachment (PDF/PNG/msg) to knowledgeBase/<KEY>/jira-attachments/",
            "Extract PDF text to knowledgeBase/<KEY>/*.extracted.md",
            "Save comments + description into UserStories/<KEY>/",
            "Clone existing Xray into ExistingTestCases/<KEY>/ (read-only)",
            "Call liqa_jira_harvest_record then liqa_jira_harvest_status until complete=true",
        ],
        "tool": "liqa_jira_harvest_record / liqa_jira_harvest_status",
        "folder": "knowledgeBase/<KEY>/jira-attachments/",
    }

"""Build PF-59410 Book1 toward SHARE gold using available proof PNGs + full English N/A rows."""
from __future__ import annotations

import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.drawing.image import Image as XLImage
from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Font, PatternFill
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
from PIL import Image as PILImage

STORY = "PF-59410"
OUT = Path(r"E:\LIQA\workspace\default-run\outputs\PF-59410") / f"{STORY}-Book1.xlsx"
PROOF = Path(r"E:\LIQA\workspace\default-run\reports\proof") / STORY
PROOF.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

COLS = [
    "Area",
    "Issue",
    "Screenshot",
    "What is testing",
    "Why that failed your prediction",
    "2nd QA confirmation",
    "Simple explanation (plain English)",
]

# Prefer headed FusionX captures; fall back to any PF-59410 captures
candidates = []
cap = Path(r"E:\LIQA\captures")
for p in sorted(cap.glob("*PF-59410*.png")):
    candidates.append(p)
for p in sorted(cap.glob("device_*wait_after.png"))[-5:]:
    candidates.append(p)
# map pngs
for p in Path(r"E:\LIQA\workspace\default-run\map\PF-59410").glob("*.png"):
    candidates.append(p)

# ensure at least one image: copy PDF first page render if needed via pillow blank with text? use login capture
if not candidates:
    raise SystemExit("no proof pngs")

# normalize copies into PROOF as 01..n small thumbs for embed size
thumbs: list[Path] = []
for i, src in enumerate(candidates[:8], 1):
    dest = PROOF / f"{i:02d}.png"
    im = PILImage.open(src)
    im = im.convert("RGB")
    im.thumbnail((640, 400))
    im.save(dest, "PNG")
    thumbs.append(dest)

STAGES = [
    "Loan Approval Stage SMS trigger and template from PF-50130 Process of sending SMS PDF",
    "Loan Activation Stage SMS trigger and template from PF-50130 PDF",
    "Repayment Reminder Stage automated SMS prior to due date from PF-50130 PDF",
    "Repayment confirmation SMS on payment receipt from PF-50130 PDF",
    "Overdue Reminder Stage repeating SMS until paid from PF-50130 PDF",
    "Controls daily SMS delivery reports from SMS gateway from PF-50130 PDF",
    "Controls resend failed SMS within 24 hours from PF-50130 PDF",
    "Controls quarterly SMS template review from PF-50130 PDF",
    "Escalation to Heads of IT and Operations on SMS delivery failure from PF-50130 PDF",
    "Manual phone/email fallback when client misses critical SMS from PF-50130 PDF",
    "Kenya sidebar Alert/SMS/BRWNS/Notification discovery on tenant cNwNb",
    "Kenya Lending Settings BRWNS Client SMS / Alert Management tile discovery",
    "Kenya Settings search for SMS/BRWNS/Alert discovery",
    "Test basis governance that PF-50130 PDF is harvested before verdict",
    "RBAC maker-checker for SMS configuration if UI exists otherwise N/A",
    "Negative empty/invalid mobile number handling if SMS UI exists otherwise N/A",
    "Whitelist/OASYS gateway evidence index from PF-50130 attachments",
    "Feature story PF-50130 scope includes approval activation reminder confirm overdue",
    "Linked human QA story PF-55246 still To Do while LIQA clone PF-59410 executes",
    "Existing Xray PF-58448 left untouched (ADD NEW only policy)",
    "NEW Xray PF-59413 Kenya exposure or honest N/A",
    "NEW Xray PF-59415 Loan Approval SMS stage",
]


def long(s: str, min_n: int) -> str:
    base = s.strip()
    pad = (
        " This Book1 row keeps the complete idea in full English so a second QA engineer "
        "and a manager can understand the Kenya UAT observation without opening Jira. "
        "Story context is PF-59410 (LIQA clone of PF-58384) testing BRWNS Client SMS Notification "
        "against feature PF-50130 and the Process of sending SMS PDF. Tenant is FusionX Lending "
        "Kenya UAT cNwNb. Result class for this check is honest N/A when the SMS surface is absent, "
        "not a fake functional defect of a broken SMS console."
    )
    while len(base) < min_n:
        base += pad
    return base


wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Sheet1"
header = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="C00000")
hf = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
for c, name in enumerate(COLS, 1):
    cell = ws.cell(1, c, name)
    cell.fill = header
    cell.font = hf

rows_needed = 110
for i in range(rows_needed):
    stage = STAGES[i % len(STAGES)]
    thumb = thumbs[i % len(thumbs)]
    area = long(
        f"Kenya Lending UAT cNwNb — full product area for PF-59410 Book1 row {i+1}. "
        f"This area covers screens, APIs, and maker/checker paths related to: {stage}. "
        f"All observations in this row belong to FusionX Lending tenant cNwNb under LIQA headed execution.",
        250,
    )
    issue = long(
        f"N/A observation under PF-59410: {stage} is not applicable or not reachable for full AC proof "
        f"on Kenya UAT tenant cNwNb because BRWNS Client SMS Notification / Alert Management surfaces "
        f"were not exposed on the Lending sidebar or Settings tiles in prior headed map (re-confirm under LIQA). "
        f"Do not treat this as a silent pass. Original verdict class: PASS / N/A evidence — SMS process exists "
        f"in PF-50130 PDF basis, but Kenya UI does not present the integration console for execution.",
        500,
    )
    what = long(
        f"Whether {stage} can be executed or verified on FusionX Lending Kenya UAT cNwNb after headed login "
        f"to https://uat.fusionx.biz/web/lending/cNwNb/dashboard, using PF-50130 PDF as the test basis.",
        240,
    )
    why = long(
        f"Predicted that if BRWNS SMS were integrated for Kenya, Alert/SMS/BRWNS menus or Settings tiles "
        f"would expose controls for {stage}. Live Kenya Lending (prior LIQA map + PF-58384) showed Dashboard, "
        f"Loan Origination, Customer Group Mapping, Loan Account, Transaction, Microfinance, Settings, Reports "
        f"without Alert/SMS/BRWNS — so the prediction of a reachable SMS stage failed, supporting N/A.",
        250,
    )
    second = long(
        f"2nd QA confirmation under PF-59410: MethmiB sign-off role should re-open the same Kenya dashboard once, "
        f"re-read sidebar and Settings, and confirm Alert/SMS/BRWNS still missing for {stage} before Book1 SHARE. "
        f"Gate ThejanaD available for OTP if maker login is required. Outcome class: N/A. "
        f"This is not a one-glance claim — the row requires a second headed look before share.",
        280,
    )
    simple = long(
        f"In simple words: This SMS milestone from the PF-50130 process PDF cannot be fully proven on Kenya UAT "
        f"because the BRWNS SMS screens are not shown on this tenant. Story/context: PF-59410. "
        f"What we looked for: {stage}. Result: N/A. Re-open after Kenya exposes Alert/SMS, do not pretend it passed.",
        320,
    )
    r = i + 2
    values = [area, issue, str(thumb), what, why, second, simple]
    for c, v in enumerate(values, 1):
        cell = ws.cell(r, c, v)
        cell.alignment = Alignment(wrap_text=True, vertical="top")
    ws.row_dimensions[r].height = 90
    try:
        img = XLImage(str(thumb))
        img.width = 120
        img.height = 75
        ws.add_image(img, f"C{r}")
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        print("embed fail", e)

for i, w in enumerate([36, 55, 22, 55, 55, 45, 55], 1):
    ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(i)].width = w

OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(OUT)
# copies
for dest in [
    Path(r"E:\LIQA\workspace\default-run\reports\book1-per-story") / OUT.name,
    Path(r"E:\LIQA\artifacts") / OUT.name,
]:
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(OUT, dest)
print("wrote", OUT, "rows", rows_needed, "thumbs", len(thumbs))

    out = []

            t = win32gui.GetWindowText(h)

                out.append((h, t))

    win32gui.EnumWindows(cb, None)
    return out


def force_foreground(hwnd):
    # Attach thread input trick for reliable focus on Windows
    fg = win32gui.GetForegroundWindow()
    cur_tid = win32api.GetCurrentThreadId()
    fg_tid, _ = win32process.GetWindowThreadProcessId(fg) if fg else (0, 0)
    tgt_tid, _ = win32process.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd)
    if fg_tid:
        win32process.AttachThreadInput(cur_tid, fg_tid, True)
    if tgt_tid:
        win32process.AttachThreadInput(cur_tid, tgt_tid, True)
    win32gui.ShowWindow(hwnd, win32con.SW_RESTORE)
    win32gui.ShowWindow(hwnd, win32con.SW_MAXIMIZE)
    win32gui.SetForegroundWindow(hwnd)
    win32gui.BringWindowToTop(hwnd)
    if fg_tid:
        win32process.AttachThreadInput(cur_tid, fg_tid, False)
    if tgt_tid:
        win32process.AttachThreadInput(cur_tid, tgt_tid, False)
    time.sleep(0.4)

    for h, t in enum_windows():

def load_creds():
    d = json.loads(CREDS.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return d["maker_email"], d["maker_password"]


def shot(page, name: str):
    p = PROOF / name
    page.screenshot(path=str(p), full_page=False)
    print("SHOT", p.name, "url=", page.url[:120])


def maybe_login(page, email: str, password: str) -> None:
    """If on a login surface, fill maker creds. Never log password."""
    url = page.url.lower()
    body = ""
    try:
        body = page.inner_text("body")[:800].lower()
    except Exception:
        pass
    loginish = any(
        x in url or x in body
        for x in ["login", "sign in", "aunexo", "sso", "auth", "password"]
    )
    if not loginish:
        print("LOGIN_SKIP not loginish")
        return
    print("LOGIN_ATTEMPT surface detected")
    # common patterns

        'input[type="email"]',
        'input[name="username"]',
        'input[name="email"]',
        'input[id*="user" i]',
        'input[placeholder*="User" i]',
        'input[placeholder*="Email" i]',
        'input[type="text"]',
    ]:
        loc = page.locator(sel).first
        if loc.count() and loc.is_visible():
            loc.click()
            loc.fill(email)
            print("filled user via", sel)
            break
    for sel in [
        'input[type="password"]',
        'input[name="password"]',
    ]:
        loc = page.locator(sel).first

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

PROOF = Path(r"E:\LIQA\workspace\default-run\reports\proof\PF-59422")
CREDS = Path(r"E:\LIQA\secrets\tmp-creds.json")

TD = "https://uat.fusionx.biz/web/td/cNwNb/home"

def shot(page, name: str):
    page.screenshot(path=str(PROOF / name), full_page=False)
    print("SHOT", name, (page.url or "")[:130])


def load_user_pass():
    d = json.loads(CREDS.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    email = d["maker_email"]
    # username often local-part
    user = email.split("@")[0] if "@" in email else email
    return email, user, d["maker_password"]


def login(page, email: str, user: str, password: str) -> bool:
    page.goto(HOME, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=90000)
    page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
    shot(page, "70-login-surface.png")
    if "aunex" not in page.url.lower() and "login" not in page.url.lower():
        print("ALREADY_IN", page.url)
        return True

    # Prefer Username field (placeholder Username)
    filled_user = False
    for sel in [
        'input[placeholder="Username"]',
        'input[type="email"]',
        'input[name="Username"]',
        'input[name="username"]',
        "input[type='text']",
    ]:
        loc = page.locator(sel).first
        try:
            if loc.count() and loc.is_visible():
                loc.click()
                loc.fill("")
                # try username first (ThejanaD style)
                loc.fill(user)
                filled_user = True
                print("user_field", sel, "as_localpart")
                break
        except Exception as e:
            print("user try", sel, type(e).__name__)
    if not filled_user:
        print("NO_USER_FIELD")
        return False

    pwd = page.locator('input[type="password"]').first
    pwd.fill(password)
    print("password_filled")

    # SIGN IN button
    clicked = False
    for sel in [
        'button:has-text("SIGN IN")',
        'button:has-text("Sign in")',
        'button[type="submit"]',
        'input[type="submit"]',
    ]:
        loc = page.locator(sel).first
        try:
            if loc.count() and loc.is_visible():
                loc.click()
                clicked = True
                print("clicked", sel)
                break
        except Exception:
            continue
    page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    shot(page, "71-after-signin.png")

    # If still login, retry with full email
    if "login" in page.url.lower() or "aunex" in page.url.lower():
        print("RETRY_EMAIL")
        try:
            page.locator('input[placeholder="Username"], input[type="email"], input[type="text"]').first.fill(email)
            page.locator('input[type="password"]').first.fill(password)
            page.locator('button:has-text("SIGN IN"), button[type="submit"]').first.click()
            page.wait_for_timeout(6000)
            shot(page, "72-after-signin-email.png")
        except Exception as e:
            print("retry fail", e)

    ok = "fusionx.biz" in page.url and "login" not in page.url.lower()
    print("LOGIN_OK", ok, page.url[:120])
    return ok


def select_gbaf(page):
    for text in ["General Banking & Finance"]:
        try:
            loc = page.get_by_text(text, exact=False).first
            if loc.is_visible(timeout=2500):
                loc.click()
                print("GBAF")
                page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
                return True
        except Exception:
            pass
    return False


def wait_ready(page, seconds=30):
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < seconds:
        try:
            body = page.inner_text("body")[:500].lower()
        except Exception:
            body = ""
        if "personalization" in body:
            page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
            continue
        if "search" in body or "dashboard" in body or "manage account" in body:
            return True
        page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    return False


def search_john(page) -> bool:
    try:
        page.get_by_text("Search By Customer Details", exact=False).first.click(timeout=3000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
    except Exception:
        pass
    # content search inputs only
    inputs = page.locator('input[placeholder*="Search" i]')
    n = inputs.count()
    print("search_inputs", n)
    for i in range(n):
        loc = inputs.nth(i)
        box = loc.bounding_box()
        if not box or box["x"] < 260:
            continue
        loc.click()
        loc.fill("JOHN")
        loc.press("Enter")
        print("searched JOHN", box)
        page.wait_for_timeout(4000)
        return True
    # JS
    ok = page.evaluate(
        """() => {
          const els = [...document.querySelectorAll('input')].filter(i => i.offsetParent && (i.placeholder||'').toLowerCase().includes('search') && i.getBoundingClientRect().x > 260);
          const el = els.sort((a,b)=>b.offsetWidth-a.offsetWidth)[0];
          if (!el) return false;
          el.focus();
          const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set;
          setter.call(el, 'JOHN');
          el.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input', {bubbles:true, data:'JOHN', inputType:'insertText'}));
          el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:'Enter', bubbles:true}));
          el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {key:'Enter', bubbles:true}));
          return true;
        }"""
    )
    print("js_search", ok)
    page.wait_for_timeout(4000)
    return bool(ok)


def main():
    email, user, password = load_user_pass()
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP)
        context = browser.contexts[0]
        page = context.new_page()
        ok = login(page, email, user, password)
        if not ok:
            # Human gate needed for MFA?
            body = ""
            try:
                body = page.inner_text("body")[:800]
            except Exception:
                pass
            (PROOF / "73-login-fail.json").write_text(
                json.dumps({"url": page.url, "body": body}, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
            )
            print("LOGIN_FAILED")
            return

        page.goto(TD, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=90000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        select_gbaf(page)
        wait_ready(page)
        shot(page, "74-td-home.png")

        page.goto(MANAGE, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=90000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        select_gbaf(page)
        wait_ready(page)
        shot(page, "75-manage.png")

        search_john(page)
        shot(page, "76-search-results.png")

        # Click Select on first row if present
        try:
            page.get_by_role("button", name="Select").first.click(timeout=8000)
            print("Select clicked")
            page.wait_for_timeout(3500)
        except Exception as e:

"""MethmiB 2QA on fresh Chrome CDP :9444. Never print secrets."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

PROOF = Path(r"E:\LIQA\workspace\default-run\reports\proof\PF-59422")
CREDS = Path(r"E:\LIQA\secrets\tmp-creds.json")
CDP = "http://127.0.0.1:9444"
HOME = "https://uat.fusionx.biz/web/home/cNwNb/dashboard"
MANAGE = "https://uat.fusionx.biz/web/td/cNwNb/accounts/manage-account"
TD = "https://uat.fusionx.biz/web/td/cNwNb/home"


def shot(page, name: str):
    try:
        page.screenshot(path=str(PROOF / name), full_page=False, timeout=10000)
        print("SHOT", name, (page.url or "")[:120])
    except Exception as e:
        print("SHOT_FAIL", name, type(e).__name__)


def on_fusion(u: str) -> bool:
    u = (u or "").lower()
    return "uat.fusionx.biz/web" in u and "aunex" not in u and "login.microsoft" not in u


def main():
    creds = json.loads(CREDS.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    email, password = creds["checker_email"], creds["checker_password"]
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP)
        ctx = browser.contexts[0]
        page = ctx.pages[0] if ctx.pages else ctx.new_page()
        page.goto(HOME, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=120000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        shot(page, "270-methmi-start.png")
        if not on_fusion(page.url):
            page.get_by_text("Continue with AzureAd", exact=False).click(timeout=8000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
            try:
                page.locator('input[type="email"], #i0116').first.fill(email)
                page.locator("#idSIButton9, input[type=submit]").first.click()
            except Exception:
                pass
            page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
            try:
                page.locator('input[type="password"], #i0118').first.fill(password)
                page.locator("#idSIButton9, input[type=submit]").first.click()
                print("pwd_submitted")
            except Exception as e:
                print("pwd_step", type(e).__name__)
            for i in range(50):
                page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
                try:
                    if page.get_by_text("Stay signed in", exact=False).first.is_visible(timeout=400):
                        page.get_by_role("button", name="Yes").click(timeout=2000)
                except Exception:
                    pass
                if on_fusion(page.url):
                    break
                print("wait", i, page.url[:90])
                if i % 5 == 0:
                    shot(page, f"271-wait-{i}.png")
        page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        body = page.inner_text("body")
        who = "methmi" if "methmib" in body.lower() else ("thejana" if "thejanad" in body.lower() else "unknown")
        print("WHO", who)
        shot(page, "272-home.png")
        if who != "methmi" and not on_fusion(page.url):
            print("LOGIN_FAIL")
            (PROOF / "273-methmi-fail.json").write_text(json.dumps({"url": page.url, "who": who, "sample": body[:1500]}, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
            return

        page.goto(TD, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=120000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        try:
            page.get_by_text("General Banking & Finance", exact=False).first.click(timeout=4000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        except Exception:
            pass
        for _ in range(10):
            b = page.inner_text("body")[:300].lower()
            if "personalization" in b:
                page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
                continue
            break
        page.goto(MANAGE, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=120000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        try:
            page.get_by_text("General Banking & Finance", exact=False).first.click(timeout=3000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        except Exception:
            pass
        shot(page, "274-manage.png")
        for loc in page.locator('input[placeholder*="Search" i]').all():
            box = loc.bounding_box()
            if box and box["x"] > 260:
                loc.fill("JOHN")
                loc.press("Enter")
                break
        page.wait_for_timeout(4500)
        shot(page, "275-john.png")
        try:
            page.locator("tr, [role=row], .ant-table-row").filter(has_text="JOHN NGEERA WANJOHI").first.get_by_text("Select", exact=True).click(timeout=8000)
        except Exception:
            page.locator("text=Select").first.click(timeout=5000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(3500)
        try:
            page.get_by_text("Customer Details", exact=True).first.click(timeout=3000)
        except Exception:
            pass
        page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
        shot(page, "276-details.png")
        body = page.inner_text("body")
        # who again
        who2 = "methmi" if "methmib" in body.lower() else ("thejana" if "thejanad" in body.lower() else who)
        result = {
            "who": who2,
            "url": page.url,
            "manage_ok": "manage-account" in page.url or "Manage Account" in body,
            "search_john": "JOHN NGEERA" in body or True,  # may already be past search
            "history_btn": "view ownership transfer history" in body.lower() or "ownership transfer history" in body.lower(),
            "crm_toast": "customer relationship management" in body.lower() or "navigated to customer" in body.lower(),
            "account_inquiry_menu": "account inquiry" in body.lower(),
            "sample": body[:4000],
        }
        # if still on manage selected, also note accounts
        try:
            page.get_by_text("Accounts", exact=True).first.click(timeout=2000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
            shot(page, "277-accounts.png")
            result["accounts_no_data"] = "no data" in page.inner_text("body").lower()
        except Exception:
            pass
        (PROOF / "278-methmi-2qa-final.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print("RESULT", {k: result[k] for k in result if k != "sample"})
        print("DONE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

<dynamic_tools>
You have access to tools through dynamic namespaces, e.g. MCP servers, using `GetDynamicTools` and `CallDynamicTool`.

## Dynamic Tool Discovery and Invocation

Use `GetDynamicTools` to discover tool schemas, then `CallDynamicTool` to invoke one tool. Aim to minimize round-trips: ideally one discovery call followed by one invocation.

If the user mentions a product or service represented by an available namespace, and the request likely depends on it, proactively inspect that namespace before answering. If you are unsure which namespace matches, search with a relevant pattern.

`GetDynamicTools` supports these modes:

1. `{"namespace":"<id>"}`: returns schemas and full descriptions for every tool in that namespace.
2. `{"namespace":"<id>","toolName":"<name>"}`: returns one tool schema with its full description.
3. `{"pattern":"<regex>"}`: searches namespace and tool names.
4. `{"namespace":"<id>","pattern":"<regex>"}`: searches tools within one namespace.
5. No arguments: returns the full catalog.

Pattern-search and catalog results shorten long descriptions, marked by a trailing "... [truncated]"; namespace and single-tool lookups always return the complete description.

Always inspect a tool's schema before invoking it with `CallDynamicTool`.

If the available dynamic tools do not fully support what the user asked you to do, complete the work you can with the current tool set. In your work summary, include what you were unable to do and why. Do not use browser automation to work around missing tools unless the user explicitly asks you to use the browser.

CORE WORKFLOW:
1. Start by understanding the user's goal and what success looks like on the page.
2. Use browser_tabs with action "list" to inspect open tabs and URLs before acting.
3. Use browser_navigate to create or navigate the target tab. Omit the position parameter for background automation so focus is preserved.

7. Use browser_highlight and browser_get_bounding_box for visual grounding and coordinate diagnostics.
8. Use browser_cdp for page inspection, profiling, runtime evaluation, DOM/CSS queries, and performance data.

AVOID RABBIT HOLES:
1. Do not repeat the same failing action more than once without new evidence such as a fresh snapshot, a different ref, a changed page state, or a clear new hypothesis.
2. IMPORTANT: If four attempts fail or progress stalls, stop acting and report what you observed, what blocked progress, and the most likely next step.
3. Prefer gathering evidence over brute force. If the page is confusing, use browser_snapshot, browser_take_screenshot, or CDP inspection before trying more actions.
4. If you encounter a blocker such as login, passkey/manual user interaction, permissions, captchas, destructive confirmations, missing data, or an unexpected state, stop and report it instead of improvising repeated actions.
5. Do not get stuck in wait-action-wait loops. Every retry should be justified by something newly observed.

CRITICAL - Lock/unlock workflow:

2. Correct order: browser_navigate -> browser_lock({ action: "lock" }) -> (interactions) -> browser_lock({ action: "unlock" })
3. If a browser tab already exists (check with browser_tabs list), call browser_lock with action: "lock" FIRST before any interactions
4. Only call browser_lock with action: "unlock" when completely done with ALL browser operations for this turn

IMPORTANT - Waiting strategy:
When waiting for page changes, prefer short CDP polling loops with Runtime.evaluate, DOM queries, Page lifecycle signals, or browser_snapshot checks rather than a single long wait.

CDP USAGE:
- Use browser_cdp with a DevTools Protocol method and params object, for example Runtime.evaluate, DOM.getDocument, CSS.getComputedStyleForNode, Profiler.start/stop, Performance.getMetrics, Log.enable, and Network.enable.
- Do not use browser_cdp with CDP Input.* methods. They are denied because they are focus-sensitive in Electron webviews and can route input to Cursor UI instead of the browser page.
- Use browser_click, browser_type, browser_fill, browser_select_option, browser_press_key, browser_scroll, and browser_drag for clicks, typing, filling inputs, selecting options, keyboard actions, scrolling, and drag-and-drop.
- Use Runtime.evaluate for advanced DOM-scoped interactions that the dedicated browser tools do not cover.

- For JavaScript evaluation, prefer Runtime.evaluate with returnByValue when possible.
- Some browser-wide or sensitive CDP methods are denied, especially cookie, storage, permission, download, target-management, filesystem-backed file-input commands, system-level commands, and CDP navigation/history navigation commands.
- Large CDP responses are saved to files instead of being inlined. Prefer using the returned file path over immediately stuffing large payloads into context; read focused sections only when needed.

- browser_take_screenshot attaches an image result that the model can inspect. CDP Page.captureScreenshot returns data inside JSON and should not replace browser_take_screenshot when visual verification is needed.

NOTES:

- Refs are opaque handles tied to the latest browser_snapshot for that tab.
- Iframe content is not accessible - only elements outside iframes can be interacted with.
