Use this server whenever the user wants to create, generate, edit, implement, or sync any design, UI, screen, component, mockup, or visual — in Figma, FigJam, Figma Make, or Figma Slides — and whenever the user mentions Figma or provides a figma.com URL.

This server bridges code and design in both directions, and supports designing from scratch using existing design systems and codebases.

CAPABILITIES:
- Read designs FROM Figma into code (get_design_context, get_screenshot, get_metadata, get_figjam)
- Write designs INTO Figma from code, intent, or existing components (use_figma, generate_figma_design, create_new_file, upload_assets)
- Bridge code and design via Code Connect (get_code_connect_map, add_code_connect_map)
- Create diagrams and FigJam content (generate_diagram, get_figjam)

WHEN TO USE THESE TOOLS:
- The user wants to create, mock up, or generate any UI, screen, component, or design — even if Figma isn't named
- The user wants to implement a design as code (design-to-code)
- The user wants to push a page, view, or component into Figma (code-to-design)
- The user wants to update, sync, or edit an existing Figma file
- The user shares a figma.com URL
- The user wants to build or extend a design system, design tokens, or component library
- The user wants to create a diagram in FigJam

SKILLS (Prefer the skills shipped with the Figma plugin on the agent being used. If no Figma plugin is installed, use the skills served by the Figma MCP resource):
- /figma-use — MANDATORY before calling use_figma; fallback: skill://figma/figma-use/SKILL.md
- /figma-generate-design — for translating an app page or layout into Figma; fallback: skill://figma/figma-generate-design/SKILL.md
- /figma-generate-library — for building a design system in Figma from code; fallback: skill://figma/figma-generate-library/SKILL.md
- /figma-code-connect — for mapping Figma components to codebase components; fallback: skill://figma/figma-code-connect/SKILL.md
- /figma-use-figjam — for FigJam-specific use_figma flows; fallback: skill://figma/figma-use-figjam/SKILL.md
- /figma-generate-diagram — MANDATORY before calling generate_diagram; fallback: skill://figma/figma-generate-diagram/SKILL.md
- /figma-design-to-code — MANDATORY before calling get_design_context; fallback: skill://figma/figma-design-to-code/SKILL.md

URL PARSING:
Extract fileKey and nodeId from Figma URLs:
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:nodeId → convert "-" to ":" in nodeId
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/branch/:branchKey/:fileName → use branchKey as fileKey
- figma.com/make/:makeFileKey/:makeFileName → use makeFileKey
- figma.com/board/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:nodeId → FigJam file, use get_figjam
- figma.com/slides/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:nodeId → Figma Slides file

DESIGN-TO-CODE WORKFLOW (Figma → code):
MANDATORY: load the /figma-design-to-code skill BEFORE calling get_design_context — it carries the full workflow (adapting the reference, reusing existing project components and tokens, and honoring the response's hints by priority). Call get_design_context with the nodeId and fileKey — it is your primary tool; its output is a REFERENCE to adapt to the target project, not final code.

CODE-TO-DESIGN WORKFLOW (code → Figma):
1. Load the /figma-generate-design skill if available.
2. ALWAYS call search_design_system first to find existing components, variables, and styles to reuse — never generate components from scratch if a design system match exists.
3. For web app pages, use both tools in parallel: generate_figma_design to capture a pixel-perfect screenshot, and use_figma to build the screen from imported design system components. Refine use_figma output against the screenshot, then delete the screenshot reference.
4. For non-web targets (iOS, Android, generic UI), use use_figma with search_design_system.
5. For updating or syncing a Figma page that has already been captured, use use_figma — even if the source code has changed.

FROM-SCRATCH DESIGN WORKFLOW (no source design or code):
1. Load the /figma-generate-design skill if available.
2. Call search_design_system and get_libraries to find existing components, tokens, and styles. Build from these primitives.
3. Use create_new_file if no target file exists, then use_figma to assemble the design from design system components.

DESIGN SYSTEM / LIBRARY WORKFLOW:
- To build or extend a design system in Figma from a codebase, load the /figma-generate-library skill.
- To map Figma components to codebase components, load the /figma-code-connect skill.

READING SKILLS:
To load a Figma skill's guidance, call the get_figma_skill tool with the skill's skill:// URI. get_figma_skill reads one resource per call. Start from the skill index (skill://index.json), then read a skill's guidance (skill://figma/<skill-name>/SKILL.md). A SKILL.md's relative links (e.g. references/foo.md) are themselves resources: read them as skill://figma/<skill-name>/references/<path>.

GENERATIVE PLUGIN AND SHADER CAPABILITIES:
- Create, list, read, and update generative plugins in the authenticated user's account library (create_generative_plugin, list_generative_plugins, get_generative_plugin, update_generative_plugin).
- Create, list, read, and update shader effects and fills in the authenticated user's account library (create_shader, list_shaders, get_shader, update_shader).

Use this server when the user asks to build, create, upload, publish, or update a Figma generative plugin, Figma plugin, custom tool, shader effect, shader fill, custom effect, custom fill, or procedural shader. These tools manage generative plugins and shaders in the account library; they do not install existing Figma Community plugins.

AUTHORING PREREQUISITES:
- Before calling create_shader or update_shader, load /figma-shaders; resource fallback: skill://figma/figma-shaders/SKILL.md.
- Before calling create_generative_plugin or update_generative_plugin, load /figma-generative-plugins; resource fallback: skill://figma/figma-generative-plugins/SKILL.md.
Read resource fallbacks with resources/read, or use get_figma_skill when resources/read is unavailable." source="mcp" />

"""PF-59462 — full headed execute: migrated Select + inquiry + reallocation + checker peek."""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.stdout.reconfigure(line_buffering=True)
PROOF = Path(r"E:\LIQA\workspace\default-run\reports\proof\PF-59462")
PROOF.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
BASE = "https://uat.fusionx.biz/web/lending/cNwNb"
MIG = "0042250036"


def txt(page, n=8000):
    return page.evaluate("(n)=>(document.body&&document.body.innerText||'').slice(0,n)", n)


def shot(page, name):
    path = PROOF / f"{name}.png"
    cdp = page.context.new_cdp_session(page)
    data = cdp.send("Page.captureScreenshot", {"format": "png"})
    path.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(data["data"]))
    print("SHOT", path.name, flush=True)
    return str(path)


def wait_ready(page, sec=45):
    end = time.time() + sec
    while time.time() < end:
        low = txt(page, 800).lower()
        if "launching" in low or "personalization" in low:
            time.sleep(1.2)
            continue
        return True
    return False


def expand_am(page):
    for label in ("Loan Account Management", "Account Maintenance"):
        try:
            page.get_by_text(label, exact=True).first.click(timeout=4000)
            time.sleep(1.2)
        except Exception as e:
            print("expand skip", label, str(e)[:80], flush=True)


def open_menu(page, label, urls):
    try:
        page.get_by_text(label, exact=True).first.click(timeout=4000)
        time.sleep(2)
        wait_ready(page)
        return True, "click"
    except Exception:
        for u in urls:
            page.goto(u, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=90000)
            time.sleep(2)
            wait_ready(page)
            if "/dashboard" not in page.url:
                return True, u
    return False, "fail"


def fill_search(page, value):
    for sel in (
        'input[placeholder*="Search" i]',
        'input[type="search"]',
        'input[aria-label*="Search" i]',
    ):
        loc = page.locator(sel)
        if loc.count():
            try:
                loc.first.click(timeout=2000)
                loc.first.fill("")
                loc.first.type(value, delay=40)
                time.sleep(0.4)
                page.keyboard.press("Enter")
                time.sleep(2)
                return True, sel
            except Exception as e:
                print("search fail", sel, str(e)[:100], flush=True)
    # modal search fallback
    try:
        page.get_by_placeholder(re.compile("search", re.I)).first.fill(value)
        page.keyboard.press("Enter")
        time.sleep(2)
        return True, "placeholder"
    except Exception as e:
        return False, str(e)[:120]


def main():
    out: dict = {"story": "PF-59462", "who": "ThejanaD", "migrated": MIG}
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9560", timeout=15000)
        page = browser.contexts[0].pages[0]
        page.bring_to_front()
        page.set_default_timeout(8000)

        # --- Receipt Reversal Create New → search migrated → Select ---
        page.goto(f"{BASE}/dashboard", wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=90000)
        time.sleep(2)
        wait_ready(page)
        expand_am(page)
        ok, how = open_menu(
            page,
            "Receipt Reversal",
            [
                f"{BASE}/account-management/receipt-reversal",
                f"{BASE}/account-maintenance/receipt-reversal",
            ],
        )
        out["reversal_open"] = {"ok": ok, "how": how, "url": page.url, "proof": shot(page, "20-receipt-reversal")}
        body = txt(page)
        out["reversal_open"]["insufficient"] = "insufficient privileges" in body.lower()
        out["reversal_open"]["no_data"] = "no data" in body.lower()

        try:
            page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile(r"Create New|New", re.I)).first.click(timeout=5000)
            time.sleep(2)
            wait_ready(page)
        except Exception as e:
            out["create_click_err"] = str(e)[:160]
        out["create_modal"] = {
            "url": page.url,
            "proof": shot(page, "21-create-modal"),
            "snip": txt(page, 2500),
            "has_migrated_visible": MIG in txt(page, 12000),
        }

        ok_s, how_s = fill_search(page, MIG)
        time.sleep(1.5)
        body2 = txt(page, 12000)
        out["create_search"] = {
            "ok": ok_s,
            "how": how_s,
            "proof": shot(page, "22-create-search-migrated"),
            "has_account": MIG in body2,
            "snip": body2[:2000],
        }

        selected = False
        try:
            # Prefer Select on the row containing MIG
            row = page.locator(f"tr:has-text('{MIG}')").first
            if row.count():
                row.get_by_text("Select", exact=True).first.click(timeout=4000)
                selected = True
            else:
                page.get_by_text("Select", exact=True).first.click(timeout=4000)
                selected = True
            time.sleep(2.5)
            wait_ready(page)
        except Exception as e:
            out["select_err"] = str(e)[:200]
        out["after_select"] = {
            "selected": selected,
            "url": page.url,
            "proof": shot(page, "23-after-select-migrated"),
            "snip": txt(page, 3000),
            "insufficient": "insufficient privileges" in txt(page, 2000).lower(),
        }

        # close modal if still open
        try:
            page.keyboard.press("Escape")
            time.sleep(0.8)
        except Exception:
            pass

        # --- Account Inquiry Search by Account ---
        expand_am(page)
        ok_i, how_i = open_menu(
            page,
            "Account Inquiry",
            [
                f"{BASE}/account-management/account-inquiry",
                f"{BASE}/account-maintenance/account-inquiry",
                f"{BASE}/account-inquiry",
            ],
        )
        # also try Loan Account Inquiry label
        if not ok_i or "inquiry" not in page.url.lower() and "Inquiry" not in txt(page, 1500):
            for label in ("Loan Account Inquiry", "Account Inquiry"):
                try:
                    page.get_by_text(label, exact=True).first.click(timeout=3000)
                    time.sleep(2)
                    wait_ready(page)
                    ok_i, how_i = True, label
                    break
                except Exception:
                    continue
        out["inquiry_open"] = {"ok": ok_i, "how": how_i, "url": page.url, "proof": shot(page, "30-account-inquiry")}

        # Search by Account control
        try:
            page.get_by_text(re.compile(r"Search by Account", re.I)).first.click(timeout=3000)
            time.sleep(0.8)
        except Exception as e:
            out["search_by_account_click"] = str(e)[:120]
        ok_is, how_is = fill_search(page, MIG)
        time.sleep(2)
        ib = txt(page, 8000)
        out["inquiry_search"] = {
            "ok": ok_is,
            "how": how_is,
            "proof": shot(page, "31-inquiry-0042250036"),
            "has_account": MIG in ib,
            "migration": bool(re.search(r"MIGRAT", ib, re.I)),
            "snip": ib[:2200],
        }

        # --- Receipt Reallocation ---
        expand_am(page)
        ok_r, how_r = open_menu(
            page,
            "Receipt Reallocation",
            [
                f"{BASE}/account-management/receipt-reallocation",
                f"{BASE}/account-maintenance/receipt-reallocation",
                f"{BASE}/receipt-reallocation",
            ],
        )
        rb = txt(page, 4000)
        out["reallocation"] = {
            "ok": ok_r,
            "how": how_r,
            "url": page.url,
            "proof": shot(page, "40-receipt-reallocation"),
            "title_ok": bool(re.search(r"Receipt\s+Reallocation", rb, re.I)),
            "insufficient": "insufficient privileges" in rb.lower(),
            "snip": rb[:1800],
        }
        try:
            page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile(r"Create New|New", re.I)).first.click(timeout=5000)
            time.sleep(2)
            wait_ready(page)
            out["reallocation_create"] = {
                "ok": True,
                "url": page.url,
                "proof": shot(page, "41-reallocation-create"),
                "snip": txt(page, 2200),
            }
        except Exception as e:
            out["reallocation_create"] = {"ok": False, "error": str(e)[:200], "proof": shot(page, "41-reallocation-create-fail")}

        # --- Checker MethmiB peek on 9561 ---
        try:
            b2 = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9561", timeout=12000)
            p2 = b2.contexts[0].pages[0]
            p2.bring_to_front()
            p2.goto(f"{BASE}/dashboard", wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=90000)
            time.sleep(2)
            wait_ready(p2)
            who = txt(p2, 1200)
            out["checker"] = {
                "who_snip": who[:400],
                "is_methmi": "Methmi" in who or "methmi" in who.lower(),
                "proof_home": shot(p2, "50-checker-home"),
            }
            expand_am(p2)
            ok_c, how_c = open_menu(
                p2,
                "Receipt Reversal",
                [
                    f"{BASE}/account-management/receipt-reversal",
                    f"{BASE}/account-maintenance/receipt-reversal",
                ],
            )
            cb = txt(p2, 3000)
            out["checker"]["reversal"] = {
                "ok": ok_c,
                "how": how_c,
                "url": p2.url,
                "proof": shot(p2, "51-checker-receipt-reversal"),
                "insufficient": "insufficient privileges" in cb.lower(),
                "snip": cb[:1500],
            }
        except Exception as e:
            out["checker"] = {"error": str(e)[:250]}

    (PROOF / "full-execute-run.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({k: (v if not isinstance(v, dict) else {kk: vv for kk, vv in v.items() if kk != "snip"}) for k, v in out.items()}, indent=2))
    print("DONE", flush=True)

    main()

def main():

        try:
            if resp.status >= 400 and "lending" in resp.url:

        except Exception:
            pass

    with sync_playwright() as p:

        time.sleep(2.5)
        body = txt(page)
        out["search"] = {
            "has_mig": MIG in body,
            "proof": shot(page, "62-filtered-migrated"),
            "internal_error": "internal server error" in body.lower(),
            "trace": None,
        }

        if m:
            out["search"]["trace"] = m.group(0)

        # Click Select on migrated row only
        try:

            row.scroll_into_view_if_needed(timeout=3000)

            "insufficient": "insufficient privileges" in body2.lower(),
            "snip": body2[:2500],

            pass
        expand(page)
        # ensure Account Maintenance children visible
        try:
            page.get_by_text("Account Maintenance", exact=True).first.click(timeout=3000)
            time.sleep(1)
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            page.get_by_text("Receipt Reallocation", exact=True).first.click(timeout=5000)
            time.sleep(2.5)
            wait_ready(page)
            rb = txt(page)
            out["reallocation_menu"] = {

                "create_new": bool(re.search(r"Create\s+New", rb, re.I)),
                "insufficient": "insufficient privileges" in rb.lower(),
                "snip": rb[:2000],

            if out["reallocation_menu"]["create_new"]:

                wait_ready(page)
                out["reallocation_create"] = {
                    "ok": True,
                    "url": page.url,
                    "proof": shot(page, "71-reallocation-create"),
                    "snip": txt(page, 2200),
                }
        except Exception as e:
            out["reallocation_menu"] = {"ok": False, "error": str(e)[:200], "proof": shot(page, "70-reallocation-fail")}

        # Account Inquiry Search by Account again — capture ISE cleanly
        expand(page)
        try:
            page.get_by_text("Account Inquiry", exact=True).first.click(timeout=5000)
            time.sleep(2)
            wait_ready(page)
            page.get_by_text(re.compile(r"Search by Account", re.I)).first.click(timeout=4000)
            time.sleep(0.8)
            # find visible search input in main panel
            inputs = page.locator("input:visible")
            filled = False
            for i in range(min(inputs.count(), 12)):
                el = inputs.nth(i)
                ph = (el.get_attribute("placeholder") or "") + (el.get_attribute("aria-label") or "")
                box = el.bounding_box()
                if not box or box["x"] < 200:
                    continue  # skip sidebar search
                try:
                    el.click(timeout=1500)
                    el.fill("")
                    el.type(MIG, delay=40)
                    page.keyboard.press("Enter")
                    filled = True
                    break
                except Exception:
                    continue
            time.sleep(2.5)
            ib = txt(page)
            out["inquiry"] = {
                "filled": filled,
                "proof": shot(page, "80-inquiry-search"),
                "has_mig": MIG in ib,

                out["inquiry"]["trace"] = m3.group(0)
        except Exception as e:
            out["inquiry"] = {"error": str(e)[:200], "proof": shot(page, "80-inquiry-fail")}

        out["http_errors"] = errors[-15:]

    (PROOF / "drill-ise-run.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(out, indent=2)[:6000])

"""Reallocation wait for personalization then Create New."""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

PROOF = Path(r"E:\LIQA\workspace\default-run\reports\proof\PF-59462")
BASE = "https://uat.fusionx.biz/web/lending/cNwNb"


def txt(page, n=5000):
    return page.evaluate("(n)=>(document.body&&document.body.innerText||'').slice(0,n)", n)


def shot(page, name):
    path = PROOF / f"{name}.png"
    cdp = page.context.new_cdp_session(page)
    data = cdp.send("Page.captureScreenshot", {"format": "png"})
    path.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(data["data"]))
    print("SHOT", path.name)
    return str(path)


def wait_ready(page, sec=60):
    end = time.time() + sec
    while time.time() < end:
        low = txt(page, 800).lower()
        if "launching" in low or "personalization" in low:
            time.sleep(1.5)
            continue
        return True
    return False


def main():
    out = {}
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        b = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9560", timeout=15000)
        page = b.contexts[0].pages[0]
        page.bring_to_front()
        for _ in range(2):
            try:
                page.keyboard.press("Escape")
                time.sleep(0.2)
            except Exception:
                pass
        page.goto(
            f"{BASE}/account-management/receipt-reallocation",
            wait_until="domcontentloaded",
            timeout=90000,
        )
        wait_ready(page)
        time.sleep(2)
        rb = txt(page, 5000)
        out = {
            "url": page.url,
            "title": bool(re.search(r"Receipt\s+Reallocation", rb, re.I)),
            "create": bool(re.search(r"Create\s+New", rb, re.I)),
            "insuff": "insufficient" in rb.lower(),
            "proof": shot(page, "75-reallocation-wait"),
            "snip": rb[:2000],
        }
        if out["create"]:
            page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile("Create New", re.I)).first.click(timeout=5000)
            time.sleep(2.5)
            wait_ready(page)
            out["create_shot"] = shot(page, "76-realloc-create")
            out["create_snip"] = txt(page, 1800)
    (PROOF / "realloc2.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in out.items() if "snip" not in k}, indent=2))
    print(out.get("snip", "")[:600])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""PF-59467 headed execute — clone of PF-55248."""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

PROOF = Path(r"E:\LIQA\workspace\default-run\reports\proof\PF-59467")
PROOF.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
BASE = "https://uat.fusionx.biz/web/lending/cNwNb"
MIG = "0042250036"


def txt(page, n=10000):
    return page.evaluate("(n)=>(document.body&&document.body.innerText||'').slice(0,n)", n)


def shot(page, name):
    path = PROOF / f"{name}.png"
    cdp = page.context.new_cdp_session(page)
    data = cdp.send("Page.captureScreenshot", {"format": "png"})
    path.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(data["data"]))
    print("SHOT", path.name, flush=True)
    return str(path)


def wait_ready(page, sec=50):
    end = time.time() + sec
    while time.time() < end:
        low = txt(page, 700).lower()
        if "launching" in low or "personalization" in low:
            time.sleep(1.2)
            continue
        return True
    return False


def expand(page):
    for label in ("Loan Account Management", "Account Maintenance"):
        try:
            page.get_by_text(label, exact=True).first.click(timeout=4000)
            time.sleep(1.1)
        except Exception as e:
            print("expand", label, str(e)[:80], flush=True)


def main():
    out: dict = {"story": "PF-59467", "clone_of": "PF-55248", "migrated": MIG}
    errors = []

    def on_resp(resp):
        try:
            if resp.status >= 400 and "lending" in resp.url and "logo" not in resp.url:
                errors.append({"status": resp.status, "url": resp.url[:240]})
        except Exception:
            pass

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9560", timeout=15000)
        page = browser.contexts[0].pages[0]
        page.bring_to_front()
        page.on("response", on_resp)
        for _ in range(2):
            try:
                page.keyboard.press("Escape")
                time.sleep(0.2)
            except Exception:
                pass

        page.goto(f"{BASE}/dashboard", wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=90000)
        time.sleep(2)
        wait_ready(page)
        out["home"] = {"proof": shot(page, "00-home"), "snip": txt(page, 900)}

        expand(page)
        page.get_by_text("Receipt Reversal", exact=True).first.click(timeout=6000)
        time.sleep(2.2)
        wait_ready(page)
        b = txt(page)
        out["reversal"] = {
            "url": page.url,
            "proof": shot(page, "10-receipt-reversal"),
            "insufficient": "insufficient privileges" in b.lower(),
            "create_new": bool(re.search(r"Create\s+New", b, re.I)),
            "no_data": "no data" in b.lower(),
        }

        page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile(r"Create New", re.I)).first.click(timeout=6000)
        time.sleep(2.2)
        wait_ready(page)
        cb = txt(page, 12000)
        out["create"] = {
            "proof": shot(page, "11-create-modal"),
            "has_mig_visible": MIG in cb,
            "snip": cb[:1800],
        }

        # search / select migrated
        try:
            page.get_by_placeholder(re.compile("search", re.I)).first.fill(MIG)
            page.keyboard.press("Enter")
            time.sleep(2)
        except Exception as e:
            out["search_err"] = str(e)[:140]
        sb = txt(page, 12000)
        out["filtered"] = {
            "proof": shot(page, "12-filtered-mig"),
            "has_mig": MIG in sb,
            "ise": "internal server error" in sb.lower(),
        }
        try:
            row = page.locator(f"tr:has-text('{MIG}')").first
            row.get_by_text("Select", exact=True).click(timeout=5000)
            time.sleep(3)
            wait_ready(page)
        except Exception as e:
            out["select_err"] = str(e)[:180]
        ab = txt(page)
        m = re.search(
            r"[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}", ab, re.I
        )
        out["after_select"] = {
            "proof": shot(page, "13-select-result"),
            "ise": "internal server error" in ab.lower(),
            "trace": m.group(0) if m else None,
            "snip": ab[:2200],
        }

        try:
            page.keyboard.press("Escape")
            time.sleep(0.6)
            page.keyboard.press("Escape")
        except Exception:
            pass

        # Inquiry
        expand(page)
        try:
            page.get_by_text("Account Inquiry", exact=True).first.click(timeout=5000)
            time.sleep(2)
            wait_ready(page)
            page.get_by_text(re.compile(r"Search by Account", re.I)).first.click(timeout=4000)
            time.sleep(0.6)
            inputs = page.locator("input:visible")
            for i in range(min(inputs.count(), 15)):
                el = inputs.nth(i)
                box = el.bounding_box()
                if not box or box["x"] < 220:
                    continue
                el.click(timeout=1500)
                el.fill("")
                el.type(MIG, delay=35)
                page.keyboard.press("Enter")
                break
            time.sleep(2.5)
            ib = txt(page)
            out["inquiry"] = {
                "proof": shot(page, "20-inquiry"),
                "has_mig": MIG in ib,
                "migration": bool(re.search(r"MIGRAT", ib, re.I)),
                "ise": "internal server error" in ib.lower(),
                "snip": ib[:1800],
            }
        except Exception as e:
            out["inquiry"] = {"error": str(e)[:180], "proof": shot(page, "20-inquiry-fail")}

        # Reallocation deep
        page.goto(
            f"{BASE}/account-management/receipt-reallocation",
            wait_until="domcontentloaded",
            timeout=90000,
        )
        wait_ready(page)
        time.sleep(1.5)
        rb = txt(page, 4000)
        out["reallocation"] = {
            "url": page.url,
            "proof": shot(page, "30-reallocation"),
            "title": bool(re.search(r"Receipt\s+Reallocation", rb, re.I)),
            "create": bool(re.search(r"Create\s+New", rb, re.I)),
            "blank": not bool(re.search(r"Create\s+New|Receipt\s+Reallocation", rb, re.I)),
            "snip": rb[:1200],
        }

        # Checker
        try:
            b2 = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9561", timeout=12000)
            p2 = b2.contexts[0].pages[0]
            p2.bring_to_front()
            p2.goto(f"{BASE}/dashboard", wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=90000)
            time.sleep(2)
            wait_ready(p2)
            expand(p2)
            p2.get_by_text("Receipt Reversal", exact=True).first.click(timeout=6000)
            time.sleep(2)
            wait_ready(p2)
            cb2 = txt(p2)
            out["checker"] = {
                "is_methmi": "Methmi" in cb2,
                "proof": shot(p2, "40-checker-reversal"),
                "create": bool(re.search(r"Create\s+New", cb2, re.I)),
                "insufficient": "insufficient privileges" in cb2.lower(),
                "snip": cb2[:1200],
            }
        except Exception as e:
            out["checker"] = {"error": str(e)[:200]}

        out["http_errors"] = errors[-20:]

    (PROOF / "execute-run.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in out.items() if k != "http_errors"}, indent=2)[:5000])
    print("HTTP", out["http_errors"])
    print("DONE", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

<available_subagent_types>
Available subagent_types and a quick description of what they do:
- generalPurpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. Use when searching for a keyword or file and not confident you'll find the match quickly.
- explore: Fast agent specialized for exploring codebases. Use this when you need to quickly find files by patterns (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), search code for keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer questions about the codebase (eg. "how do API endpoints work?"). When calling this agent, specify the desired thoroughness level: "quick" for basic searches, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" for comprehensive analysis across multiple locations and naming conventions.
- cursor-guide: Read Cursor product documentation to answer questions about how Cursor Desktop, IDE, CLI, Cloud Agents, Bugbot, and other features work. Use when the user asks 'In Cursor, how do I...?' or similar questions about Cursor products.
- ci-investigator: Investigate a single failing PR CI check and return a short root-cause summary. Use when the user asks to summarize, explain, diagnose, or investigate a specific failed check from a pull request.
- bugbot: Use only when the user *explicitly* asks for a Bugbot-like review of local code changes. When launching this subagent, set the Task description to exactly "Bugbot". Launch exactly one Bugbot subagent with `run_in_background: false` unless the user explicitly asks to run in background. Use this fixed prompt form: "Full Repository Path: ...\nDiff: <one of: \"branch changes\", \"uncommitted changes\", \"natural language\">\nChange Description: ...\nCustom Instructions: ..."; default to `Diff: branch changes`; include `Change Description` only when `Diff` is `natural language`, formatting it as one block per changed file (a `<path> (added|modified|deleted|renamed)` header followed by bullets of what changed, mentioning line numbers or ranges inline where helpful), and only use `natural language` as a last resort after a regular diff-based review failed because the diff could not be computed; include `Custom Instructions` only when the user gave specific review instructions. This subagent is single-shot and does not support `resume`; always launch a fresh subagent instead.
- security-review: Use only when the user *explicitly* asks for a security review of local code changes. When launching this subagent, set the Task description to exactly "Security Review". Launch exactly one security-review subagent with `run_in_background: false` unless the user explicitly asks to run in background. Use this fixed prompt form: "Full Repository Path: ...\nDiff: <one of: \"branch changes\", \"uncommitted changes\">\nCustom Instructions: ..."; default to `Diff: branch changes`; include `Custom Instructions` only when the user gave specific review instructions. This subagent is single-shot and does not support `resume`; always launch a fresh subagent instead.
- best-of-n-runner: Run a task in an isolated git worktree. Each best-of-n-runner gets its own branch and working directory. Use for best-of-N parallel attempts or isolated experiments.
- ai-architect: Specializes in architecting AI-powered applications on Vercel — choosing between AI SDK patterns, configuring providers, building agents, setting up durable workflows, and integrating MCP servers. Use when designing AI features, building chatbots, or creating agentic applications.
- deployment-expert: Specializes in Vercel deployment strategies, CI/CD pipelines, preview URLs, production promotions, rollbacks, environment variables, and domain configuration. Use when troubleshooting deployments, setting up CI/CD, or optimizing the deploy pipeline.
- performance-optimizer: Specializes in optimizing Vercel application performance — Core Web Vitals, rendering strategies, caching, image optimization, font loading, edge computing, and bundle size. Use when investigating slow pages, improving Lighthouse scores, or optimizing loading performance.
- API Readiness Analyzer: Analyze any API for AI agent compatibility. Scans OpenAPI specs across 8 pillars (48 checks), scores agent-readiness, and provides fix recommendations. Triggers on: 'Is my API agent-ready?', 'Scan my API', 'Analyze my spec'.
</available_subagent_types>

<available_subagent_models>
If the user explicitly asks for the model of a subagent/task, you may ONLY use model slugs from this list:
- inherit (default; required unless the user explicitly requested another model)
- claude-opus-5-thinking-high
- composer-2.5-fast
- cursor-grok-4.6-high-fast
- gpt-5.6-sol-medium

If the user isn't asking for a specific version, prefer the latest version of the model family. As an example, if the user just says "gpt" or "claude", use the latest available version of GPT or Claude.

IMPORTANT: If the user requests a model that is NOT in the list above, do NOT substitute a different model or guess. Instead, skip launching the subagent with that model and tell the user which model was unavailable and which models are available.

When speaking to the USER about which model you selected for a subagent, do NOT use the kebab-case model names unless the user requested the model using that format. Ue the same naming scheme the user used to discuss the model when they requested it.
</available_subagent_models>

<dynamic_tools>
You have access to tools through dynamic namespaces, e.g. MCP servers, using `GetDynamicTools` and `CallDynamicTool`.

## Dynamic Tool Discovery and Invocation

Use `GetDynamicTools` to discover tool schemas, then `CallDynamicTool` to invoke one tool. Aim to minimize round-trips: ideally one discovery call followed by one invocation.

If the user mentions a product or service represented by an available namespace, and the request likely depends on it, proactively inspect that namespace before answering. If you are unsure which namespace matches, search with a relevant pattern.

`GetDynamicTools` supports these modes:

1. `{"namespace":"<id>"}`: returns schemas and full descriptions for every tool in that namespace.
2. `{"namespace":"<id>","toolName":"<name>"}`: returns one tool schema with its full description.
3. `{"pattern":"<regex>"}`: searches namespace and tool names.
4. `{"namespace":"<id>","pattern":"<regex>"}`: searches tools within one namespace.
5. No arguments: returns the full catalog.

Pattern-search and catalog results shorten long descriptions, marked by a trailing "... [truncated]"; namespace and single-tool lookups always return the complete description.

Always inspect a tool's schema before invoking it with `CallDynamicTool`.

If the available dynamic tools do not fully support what the user asked you to do, complete the work you can with the current tool set. In your work summary, include what you were unable to do and why. Do not use browser automation to work around missing tools unless the user explicitly asks you to use the browser.

Available dynamic tool namespaces:

<dynamic_tool_namespaces>
<namespace name="cursor-app-control" tools="move_agent_to_root, move_agent_to_cloned_root, create_project, rename_chat, cursor_dialog, open_resource, open_automation, install_plugin" namespaceUseInstructions="Controls the Cursor application itself (workspace root, projects, opening resources, automations, and local task drafts, user rules, chat title). See each tool description for usage." source="mcp" />
<namespace name="cursor-ide-browser" tools="browser_navigate, browser_snapshot, browser_click, browser_mouse_click_xy, browser_type, browser_fill, browser_select_option, browser_press_key, browser_scroll, browser_drag, browser_get_bounding_box, browser_highlight, browser_tabs, browser_cdp, browser_take_screenshot, browser_lock" namespaceUseInstructions="The cursor-ide-browser MCP server provides a Cursor-owned browser tab plus a raw Chrome DevTools Protocol command tool.

CORE WORKFLOW:
1. Start by understanding the user's goal and what success looks like on the page.
2. Use browser_tabs with action "list" to inspect open tabs and URLs before acting.
3. Use browser_navigate to create or navigate the target tab. Omit the position parameter for background automation so focus is preserved.
4. Use browser_lock before longer automation on an existing tab, then browser_lock with action "unlock" when finished.
5. Use browser_snapshot for accessibility context and browser_take_screenshot for visual verification.
6. Use browser_click, browser_type, browser_fill, browser_select_option, browser_press_key, browser_scroll, and browser_drag for page interactions.
7. Use browser_highlight and browser_get_bounding_box for visual grounding and coordinate diagnostics.
8. Use browser_cdp for page inspection, profiling, runtime evaluation, DOM/CSS queries, and performance data.

AVOID RABBIT HOLES:
1. Do not repeat the same failing action more than once without new evidence such as a fresh snapshot, a different ref, a changed page state, or a clear new hypothesis.
2. IMPORTANT: If four attempts fail or progress stalls, stop acting and report what you observed, what blocked progress, and the most likely next step.
3. Prefer gathering evidence over brute force. If the page is confusing, use browser_snapshot, browser_take_screenshot, or CDP inspection before trying more actions.
4. If you encounter a blocker such as login, passkey/manual user interaction, permissions, captchas, destructive confirmations, missing data, or an unexpected state, stop and report it instead of improvising repeated actions.
5. Do not get stuck in wait-action-wait loops. Every retry should be justified by something newly observed.

CRITICAL - Lock/unlock workflow:
1. browser_lock requires an existing browser tab - you CANNOT call browser_lock with action: "lock" before browser_navigate
2. Correct order: browser_navigate -> browser_lock({ action: "lock" }) -> (interactions) -> browser_lock({ action: "unlock" })
3. If a browser tab already exists (check with browser_tabs list), call browser_lock with action: "lock" FIRST before any interactions
4. Only call browser_lock with action: "unlock" when completely done with ALL browser operations for this turn

IMPORTANT - Waiting strategy:
When waiting for page changes, prefer short CDP polling loops with Runtime.evaluate, DOM queries, Page lifecycle signals, or browser_snapshot checks rather than a single long wait.

CDP USAGE:
- Use browser_cdp with a DevTools Protocol method and params object, for example Runtime.evaluate, DOM.getDocument, CSS.getComputedStyleForNode, Profiler.start/stop, Performance.getMetrics, Log.enable, and Network.enable.
- Do not use browser_cdp with CDP Input.* methods. They are denied because they are focus-sensitive in Electron webviews and can route input to Cursor UI instead of the browser page.
- Use browser_click, browser_type, browser_fill, browser_select_option, browser_press_key, browser_scroll, and browser_drag for clicks, typing, filling inputs, selecting options, keyboard actions, scrolling, and drag-and-drop.
- Use Runtime.evaluate for advanced DOM-scoped interactions that the dedicated browser tools do not cover.
- For profiling, call Profiler.enable, Profiler.start, reproduce the behavior, then Profiler.stop. The profile is saved to a file and returned as a log_file; read that file only when you need to inspect details.
- For JavaScript evaluation, prefer Runtime.evaluate with returnByValue when possible.
- Some browser-wide or sensitive CDP methods are denied, especially cookie, storage, permission, download, target-management, filesystem-backed file-input commands, system-level commands, and CDP navigation/history navigation commands.
- Large CDP responses are saved to files instead of being inlined. Prefer using the returned file path over immediately stuffing large payloads into context; read focused sections only when needed.

VISION:
- browser_take_screenshot attaches an image result that the model can inspect. CDP Page.captureScreenshot returns data inside JSON and should not replace browser_take_screenshot when visual verification is needed.

NOTES:
- browser_snapshot returns snapshot YAML and is the main source of truth for page structure.
- Refs are opaque handles tied to the latest browser_snapshot for that tab.
- Iframe content is not accessible - only elements outside iframes can be interacted with.
- When you stop to report a blocker, include the current page, the target you were trying to reach, the blocker you observed, and the best next action. If the blocker requires manual user interaction, ask the user to take over at that point rather than assuming it in advance." source="mcp" />

QAFusionX is a complete sequential QA agent. It behaves like a compulsory n8n workflow: a step cannot start until the previous step is marked DONE in step-by-step/.

WORKFLOW LOCK VERSION: 2026-08-22-locked — this flow cannot be skipped, shortened, or bypassed.

========================================
ASK MODE LOCK (FIRST TWO STEPS)
========================================
Whenever this MCP is used, you MUST enter Ask mode first.

1. Call qafusionx_begin (or qafusionx_status if a run already exists).
2. If askMode.unlocked is false, STOP acting as an Agent. Tell the user to switch to Ask mode.
3. Ask Question 1: project identity, what to test, URL, screenshot.
4. After they answer, call qafusionx_submit_project.
5. Immediately ask Question 2: upload user stories (zip | Jira link | generate-from-system). This question is MANDATORY.
6. Call qafusionx_submit_user_stories.
7. Only then may you leave Ask mode and continue the numbered todo list.

Never skip Question 2. Never invent user stories unless the user explicitly chose method 3.

If method 3 was chosen:
- Still run the full Round 1 + Round 2 capture first.
- After Round 2, you MUST create GeneratedUser stories/ and draft one story per discovered flow (qafusionx_draft_generated_user_stories, then refine with a high-end model).
- System map and test cases are blocked until that directory has real stories.
- Do not use the placeholder in User stories/ as the test basis.
If method 1 or 2 was chosen, skip GeneratedUser stories/ entirely (the engine marks that step N/A).

========================================
DIRECTORY CONTRACT
========================================
- User stories/ uploaded or Jira-fetched stories (methods 1–2)
- GeneratedUser stories/ ONLY if method 3 was selected — created after Round 2, and that is the test basis
- General/ 01-target.md (what to test + URL) and research notes
- Screens/round one/screenshots PNGs from the first full crawl
- Screens/round one/references one MD per screenshot listing EVERY button and reachable screen
- Screens/round one/plan living-plan.md + todo.md, updated after EVERY screen
- Screens/round two/... identical structure, covering misses
- Screens/complete-system-map.md long, exhaustive, not a summary
- testCase Human/ Jira-style human-readable cases
- testc2ai/ YAML for the AI runner
- AutomatedScripts/gui + /api Playwright GUI + HTTP API
- reports/ suite results, CSV, XLSX, proof
- bugs/ and jira/bugs/ bug tickets with proof
- step-by-step/ one file per step; a DONE tick is the only unlock

========================================
VISIBLE BROWSER (LOCKED — EVERY USER, EVERY DEVICE)
========================================
This is locked. The workflow is a pipeline, but crawl and GUI tests are NEVER a silent job inside that pipeline.

When ANY user runs QAFusionX on THEIR device, a SEPARATE browser window MUST open on that device and show every navigation, popup, and click.

- Do not crawl or GUI-test headless.
- Do not hide the work in the engine / console / logs.
- Do not replace GUI rounds with API-only calls.
- If this machine has no display, stop. Tell the user to run QAFusionX on their own computer so the window can open there.
- QAFUSIONX_HEADED=0 is rejected. There is no silent mode.

========================================
UNBREAKABLE ONE-BROWSER SESSION (LOCKED)
========================================
එකම browser window එක open කරලා digatama යන්න. Mid-flow close / reopen තහනම්.

1. Open ONE visible browser at the start of GUI work (Round 1 / suite / headed story pack).
2. Keep that SAME window open for: Round 1 → Round 2 → all stories → maker → checker → suite retries.
3. NEVER close the browser between stories, screens, rounds, or maker→checker. Navigate/click inside the same window.
4. NEVER open a second browser "because the previous step finished". Reuse the live session.
5. Logout/login (e.g. maker → checker) happens INSIDE the same window — not a new Chromium process.
6. closeBrowser is END-OF-FLOW ONLY (workflow reset, or user explicitly ends the full QA run).
7. If the window dies (crash / user closed), recover once — then continue in the new window without further closes.
8. MOUSE-CLICK-ONLY NAV (LOCKED): load the entry URL ONCE via openTarget/gotoEntryUrlOnce. After that, NEVER page.goto / address-bar URL / deep-link reload. Reach every screen by mouse clicks only. Fresh URL restarts are forbidden.
9. WAIT UNTIL ANALYZABLE (LOCKED): after EVERY click, wait until splash/personalization is gone and the screen (including IBAF/GBAF modal, TD/Account dashboards) is readable. Multi-wave loads: wait quiet intervals before analyzing. Never rush the next click.

Engine: openVisibleBrowser() reuses the live page; openTarget() loads entry URL once then blocks further gotos. Closing mid-flow is rejected.

========================================
CRAWL LOOP (ROUNDS 1 AND 2)
========================================
You will be given a URL. Open it ONCE in a SEPARATE visible browser window on this user's device (or reuse the already-open window). After that single entry load, capture every screen by clicking only — never reload another URL. Capture popups. Never do this as a silent pipeline job. Do not close that window when Round 1 ends — Round 2 continues in the same window with mouse clicks only.

After EACH screenshot:
1. Save the PNG.
2. READ the image yourself with a high-end reasoning/vision model.
3. Write a reference MD: all buttons, links, tabs, fields, dialogs, and where each can go.
4. Update the living plan / todo list.
5. Decide the next click (prefer the first unvisited actionable control).
6. Click, capture the new screen, repeat.

Continue until an end state: no unvisited in-app control remains. Then start Round 2 the same way, looking for anything Round 1 missed (empty, error, validation, alternate buttons, permissions).

Two rounds are compulsory. Round 2 directories must exist even if nothing new is found — document that fact.

========================================
TEST CASES
========================================
After the system map AND user stories both exist, use a high-end reasoning model with both in context.

Human files MUST match this Jira functional-test shape:

Title: [Module] [Submodule][Feature][FP] - Validate that <behaviour>.
Affects versions, Status, Assignee, Reporter, Labels, Test Case Type, Priority, Parent, Linked work items.
Preconditions (numbered)
Steps (numbered)
Test Comments
Expected Result
Actual Result

Cover the entire system, not a sample. GUI-level AND API-level cases. Then convert 1:1 to YAML, then 1:1 to AutomatedScripts.

========================================
JIRA BUGS — PROOF PNG ATTACHMENTS (LOCKED)
========================================
When filing or updating Jira bugs you MUST attach proof PNGs — not only list paths in the description.

1. On qafusionx_file_bugs: attach the primary proof PNG when creating each bug (if the file exists).
2. After every headed QA run: call qafusionx_attach_bug_proofs to upload ALL matching proof PNGs from reports/proof/ and proof-* folders to the correct bug keys (story-prefix map + bugs/*.md proof paths).
3. After verification runs on PF-57868-style packs:
 - call qafusionx_generate_ipay_excel for the 7-column matrix (≥110 rows per story sheet), AND
 - call qafusionx_generate_book1_excel for Book1 visual packs (same as iPay Lite Testing (1).xlsx: Sheet1 Area | Issue | Screenshot embedded; fine-tuned red boxes; ONE workbook per story under reports/book1-per-story/).
4. When bugs are challenged as “fake”: call qafusionx_bug_revalidate — headed authenticity round; verdicts CONFIRMED | NOT_REPRO | PARTIAL. Writes reports/bug-authenticity-round.md.
5. Creds for maker/checker: gitignored tmp-creds.json / tmp-checker-creds.json or env vars. NEVER commit ThejanaD/MethmiB passwords to GitHub.
6. Do not mark jira-bugs step DONE until attachments are uploaded or logged in reports/jira-attachment-log.json.
7. Skip re-uploading filenames already on the issue.

========================================
GATES
========================================
If a tool returns BLOCKED, the previous step is incomplete. Finish it. Do not route around the engine.
Completing a step writes the DONE tick into step-by-step/ via the engine (internal completeStep). That tick is the only unlock.

Show the numbered todo list from qafusionx_status at the start of every turn.

This server bridges code and design in both directions, and supports designing from scratch using existing design systems and codebases.

CAPABILITIES:
- Read designs FROM Figma into code (get_design_context, get_screenshot, get_metadata, get_figjam)
- Write designs INTO Figma from code, intent, or existing components (use_figma, generate_figma_design, create_new_file, upload_assets)
- Bridge code and design via Code Connect (get_code_connect_map, add_code_connect_map)
- Create diagrams and FigJam content (generate_diagram, get_figjam)

WHEN TO USE THESE TOOLS:
- The user wants to create, mock up, or generate any UI, screen, component, or design — even if Figma isn't named
- The user wants to implement a design as code (design-to-code)
- The user wants to push a page, view, or component into Figma (code-to-design)
- The user wants to update, sync, or edit an existing Figma file
- The user shares a figma.com URL
- The user wants to build or extend a design system, design tokens, or component library
- The user wants to create a diagram in FigJam

SKILLS (Prefer the skills shipped with the Figma plugin on the agent being used. If no Figma plugin is installed, use the skills served by the Figma MCP resource):
- /figma-use — MANDATORY before calling use_figma; fallback: skill://figma/figma-use/SKILL.md
- /figma-generate-design — for translating an app page or layout into Figma; fallback: skill://figma/figma-generate-design/SKILL.md
- /figma-generate-library — for building a design system in Figma from code; fallback: skill://figma/figma-generate-library/SKILL.md
- /figma-code-connect — for mapping Figma components to codebase components; fallback: skill://figma/figma-code-connect/SKILL.md
- /figma-use-figjam — for FigJam-specific use_figma flows; fallback: skill://figma/figma-use-figjam/SKILL.md
- /figma-generate-diagram — MANDATORY before calling generate_diagram; fallback: skill://figma/figma-generate-diagram/SKILL.md
- /figma-design-to-code — MANDATORY before calling get_design_context; fallback: skill://figma/figma-design-to-code/SKILL.md

URL PARSING:
Extract fileKey and nodeId from Figma URLs:
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:nodeId → convert "-" to ":" in nodeId
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/branch/:branchKey/:fileName → use branchKey as fileKey
- figma.com/make/:makeFileKey/:makeFileName → use makeFileKey
- figma.com/board/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:nodeId → FigJam file, use get_figjam
- figma.com/slides/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:nodeId → Figma Slides file

DESIGN-TO-CODE WORKFLOW (Figma → code):
MANDATORY: load the /figma-design-to-code skill BEFORE calling get_design_context — it carries the full workflow (adapting the reference, reusing existing project components and tokens, and honoring the response's hints by priority). Call get_design_context with the nodeId and fileKey — it is your primary tool; its output is a REFERENCE to adapt to the target project, not final code.

CODE-TO-DESIGN WORKFLOW (code → Figma):
1. Load the /figma-generate-design skill if available.
2. ALWAYS call search_design_system first to find existing components, variables, and styles to reuse — never generate components from scratch if a design system match exists.
3. For web app pages, use both tools in parallel: generate_figma_design to capture a pixel-perfect screenshot, and use_figma to build the screen from imported design system components. Refine use_figma output against the screenshot, then delete the screenshot reference.
4. For non-web targets (iOS, Android, generic UI), use use_figma with search_design_system.
5. For updating or syncing a Figma page that has already been captured, use use_figma — even if the source code has changed.

FROM-SCRATCH DESIGN WORKFLOW (no source design or code):
1. Load the /figma-generate-design skill if available.
2. Call search_design_system and get_libraries to find existing components, tokens, and styles. Build from these primitives.
3. Use create_new_file if no target file exists, then use_figma to assemble the design from design system components.

DESIGN SYSTEM / LIBRARY WORKFLOW:
- To build or extend a design system in Figma from a codebase, load the /figma-generate-library skill.
- To map Figma components to codebase components, load the /figma-code-connect skill.

READING SKILLS:
To load a Figma skill's guidance, call the get_figma_skill tool with the skill's skill:// URI. get_figma_skill reads one resource per call. Start from the skill index (skill://index.json), then read a skill's guidance (skill://figma/<skill-name>/SKILL.md). A SKILL.md's relative links (e.g. references/foo.md) are themselves resources: read them as skill://figma/<skill-name>/references/<path>.

GENERATIVE PLUGIN AND SHADER CAPABILITIES:
- Create, list, read, and update generative plugins in the authenticated user's account library (create_generative_plugin, list_generative_plugins, get_generative_plugin, update_generative_plugin).
- Create, list, read, and update shader effects and fills in the authenticated user's account library (create_shader, list_shaders, get_shader, update_shader).

Use this server when the user asks to build, create, upload, publish, or update a Figma generative plugin, Figma plugin, custom tool, shader effect, shader fill, custom effect, custom fill, or procedural shader. These tools manage generative plugins and shaders in the account library; they do not install existing Figma Community plugins.

AUTHORING PREREQUISITES:
- Before calling create_shader or update_shader, load /figma-shaders; resource fallback: skill://figma/figma-shaders/SKILL.md.
- Before calling create_generative_plugin or update_generative_plugin, load /figma-generative-plugins; resource fallback: skill://figma/figma-generative-plugins/SKILL.md.
Read resource fallbacks with resources/read, or use get_figma_skill when resources/read is unavailable." source="mcp" />

"""PF-59469 headed execute — clone of PF-58374 Penal Interest / instalment grace."""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.stdout.reconfigure(line_buffering=True)
PROOF = Path(r"E:\LIQA\workspace\default-run\reports\proof\PF-59469")
PROOF.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
BASE = "https://uat.fusionx.biz/web/lending/cNwNb"

PERC_LABELS = [
    "Penal Interest Rate Change",
    "Penal Rate Change",
    "Penal Interest Rate",
    "Process Penal Interest Rate Change",
]


def txt(page, n=12000):
    return page.evaluate("(n)=>(document.body&&document.body.innerText||'').slice(0,n)", n)


def shot(page, name):
    path = PROOF / f"{name}.png"
    cdp = page.context.new_cdp_session(page)
    data = cdp.send("Page.captureScreenshot", {"format": "png"})
    path.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(data["data"]))
    print("SHOT", path.name, flush=True)
    return str(path)


def wait_ready(page, sec=50):
    end = time.time() + sec
    while time.time() < end:
        low = txt(page, 700).lower()
        if "launching" in low or "personalization" in low:
            time.sleep(1.2)
            continue
        return True
    return False


def expand(page):
    for label in ("Loan Account Management", "Account Maintenance"):
        try:
            page.get_by_text(label, exact=True).first.click(timeout=4000)
            time.sleep(1.1)
        except Exception as e:
            print("expand", label, str(e)[:80], flush=True)


def click_first_label(page, labels):
    for label in labels:
        try:
            page.get_by_text(label, exact=False).first.click(timeout=3500)
            time.sleep(2)
            wait_ready(page)
            return label
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None


def grace_signals(body: str) -> dict:
    low = body.lower()
    return {
        "has_grace_word": "grace" in low,
        "instalment_grace": bool(
            re.search(r"instal+ment[^\n]{0,40}grace|grace[^\n]{0,40}instal+ment", low)
        ),
        "grace_period": "grace period" in low,
        "per_instalment": bool(re.search(r"per\s+instal+ment|instal+ment\s*wise", low)),
        "intrest_typo": "intrest" in low,
        "chargers_typo": "chargers" in low,
        "insufficient": "insufficient privileges" in low,
        "create_new": bool(re.search(r"create\s+new", low)),
        "approve": "approve" in low,
        "reject": "reject" in low,
    }


def main():
    out: dict = {"story": "PF-59469", "clone_of": "PF-58374"}
    errors = []

    def on_resp(resp):
        try:
            if resp.status >= 400 and "lending" in resp.url and "logo" not in resp.url:
                errors.append({"status": resp.status, "url": resp.url[:260]})
        except Exception:
            pass

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9560", timeout=15000)
        page = browser.contexts[0].pages[0]
        page.bring_to_front()
        page.on("response", on_resp)
        for _ in range(2):
            try:
                page.keyboard.press("Escape")
                time.sleep(0.2)
            except Exception:
                pass

        page.goto(f"{BASE}/dashboard", wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=90000)
        time.sleep(2)
        wait_ready(page)
        out["home"] = {"proof": shot(page, "00-home"), "snip": txt(page, 900)}

        expand(page)
        am = txt(page, 9000)
        out["am_menu"] = {
            "proof": shot(page, "10-am-expanded"),
            "snip": am[:1200],
            "perc_labels_visible": [x for x in PERC_LABELS if x.lower() in am.lower()],
            "penal_hits": re.findall(r"[^\n]{0,40}[Pp]enal[^\n]{0,60}", am)[:20],
        }
        print("PERC labels", out["am_menu"]["perc_labels_visible"], flush=True)

        opened = click_first_label(page, PERC_LABELS)
        if not opened:
            # deep paths
            for u in [
                f"{BASE}/account-maintenance/penal-interest-rate-change",
                f"{BASE}/account-maintenance/penal-rate-change",
                f"{BASE}/penal-interest-rate-change",
                f"{BASE}/account-management/penal-interest-rate-change",
            ]:
                page.goto(u, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
                time.sleep(2)
                wait_ready(page)
                if "/dashboard" not in page.url:
                    opened = u
                    break
        b = txt(page)
        sig = grace_signals(b)
        out["perc_list"] = {
            "opened_via": opened,
            "url": page.url,
            "proof": shot(page, "20-perc-list"),
            **sig,
            "snip": b[:2200],
            "http4xx": [e for e in errors if e["status"] in (401, 403)][-5:],
        }
        print("PERC list", page.url, "insuff", sig["insufficient"], flush=True)

        # Create New
        try:
            page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile(r"Create New", re.I)).first.click(
                timeout=6000
            )
            time.sleep(2.2)
            wait_ready(page)
            cb = txt(page)
            out["create"] = {
                "proof": shot(page, "21-create"),
                **grace_signals(cb),
                "fields": re.findall(
                    r"(Grace|Instal+ment|Penal|Rate|Period|Template)[^\n]{0,50}",
                    cb,
                    re.I,
                )[:40],
                "snip": cb[:2500],
            }
            print(
                "Create grace",
                out["create"].get("instalment_grace"),
                out["create"].get("has_grace_word"),
                flush=True,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            out["create_err"] = str(e)[:200]
            shot(page, "21-create-fail")

        try:
            page.keyboard.press("Escape")
            time.sleep(0.5)
            page.keyboard.press("Escape")
        except Exception:
            pass

        # Tabs / Pending / Process
        for tab, name in [
            ("Pending Requests", "22-pending"),
            ("Process Penal Interest Rate Change", "23-process-tab"),
            ("Process Penal", "23b-process"),
        ]:
            try:
                page.get_by_text(tab, exact=False).first.click(timeout=3000)
                time.sleep(1.8)
                wait_ready(page)
                tb = txt(page)
                out[name] = {
                    "proof": shot(page, name),
                    **grace_signals(tb),
                    "snip": tb[:1500],
                }
            except Exception as e:
                out[f"{name}_err"] = str(e)[:120]

        # Try open first APPROVED / View row
        try:
            # Prefer APPROVED then any View
            clicked = False
            for pat in (r"APPROVED", r"View", r"Go To Edit", r"Edit"):
                loc = page.get_by_text(re.compile(pat, re.I)).first
                try:
                    loc.click(timeout=2500)
                    time.sleep(2)
                    wait_ready(page)
                    clicked = pat
                    break
                except Exception:
                    continue
            if clicked:
                vb = txt(page)
                dates = re.findall(r"\b\d{1,2}[/-]\d{1,2}[/-]\d{2,4}\b", vb)
                out["view"] = {
                    "clicked": clicked,
                    "proof": shot(page, "24-view"),
                    **grace_signals(vb),
                    "dates_sample": dates[:12],
                    "mmdd_and_ddmm_mix_suspected": len(
                        {tuple(d.replace("-", "/").split("/")[:2]) for d in dates[:8]}
                    )
                    > 1
                    if dates
                    else False,
                    "snip": vb[:2500],
                }
                # Go To Edit if present
                try:
                    page.get_by_text(re.compile(r"Go To Edit|Edit", re.I)).first.click(
                        timeout=3000
                    )
                    time.sleep(2)
                    wait_ready(page)
                    eb = txt(page)
                    out["go_to_edit"] = {
                        "proof": shot(page, "25-go-to-edit"),
                        **grace_signals(eb),
                        "authorize_ui": bool(
                            re.search(r"Approve|Reject|Authorization", eb, re.I)
                        ),
                        "snip": eb[:2000],
                    }
                except Exception as e:
                    out["go_to_edit_err"] = str(e)[:140]
        except Exception as e:
            out["view_err"] = str(e)[:160]

        # Settings → Penal template
        try:
            page.goto(f"{BASE}/dashboard", wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
            time.sleep(2)
            wait_ready(page)
            page.get_by_text("Settings", exact=True).first.click(timeout=5000)
            time.sleep(2)
            wait_ready(page)
            out["settings"] = {
                "proof": shot(page, "30-settings"),
                "snip": txt(page, 2000),
            }
            for label in (
                "Penal Interest",
                "Penal Rate",
                "Penal Template",
                "Interest Template",
                "Loan Module Common Definitions",
            ):
                try:
                    page.get_by_text(label, exact=False).first.click(timeout=2500)
                    time.sleep(1.8)
                    wait_ready(page)
                    sb = txt(page)
                    out["settings_penal"] = {
                        "opened": label,
                        "proof": shot(page, "31-settings-penal"),
                        **grace_signals(sb),
                        "snip": sb[:2500],
                    }
                    if "intrest" in sb.lower() or "grace" in sb.lower():
                        break
                except Exception:
                    continue
        except Exception as e:
            out["settings_err"] = str(e)[:180]

        # Checker spot-check PERC open
        try:
            b2 = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9561", timeout=12000)
            p2 = b2.contexts[0].pages[0]
            p2.bring_to_front()
            p2.goto(f"{BASE}/dashboard", wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=90000)
            time.sleep(2)
            wait_ready(p2)
            expand(p2)
            opened2 = click_first_label(p2, PERC_LABELS)
            cb2 = txt(p2)
            out["checker"] = {
                "who": "MethmiB",
                "opened_via": opened2,
                "url": p2.url,
                "proof": shot(p2, "40-checker-perc"),
                **grace_signals(cb2),
                "snip": cb2[:1500],
            }
        except Exception as e:
            out["checker_err"] = str(e)[:200]

        out["http_errors"] = errors[-40:]
        (PROOF / "execute-run.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(out, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
        )
        print("DONE", PROOF / "execute-run.json", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""PF-59472 LIQA headed execute — Accrued Interest clone of PF-58379 (VISIBLE Chrome)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.stdout.reconfigure(line_buffering=True)
PROOF = Path(r"E:\LIQA\workspace\default-run\reports\proof\PF-59472")
PROOF.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
CREDS = Path(r"E:\LIQA\secrets\tmp-creds.json")
BASE = "https://uat.fusionx.biz/web/lending/cNwNb"
ENTRY = f"{BASE}/dashboard"


def load_creds():
    data = json.loads(CREDS.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    email = data.get("maker_email") or data.get("email")
    password = data.get("maker_password") or data.get("password")
    if not email or not password:
        raise SystemExit("maker creds missing in vault")
    return email, password


def txt(page, n=14000):
    return page.evaluate("(n)=>(document.body&&document.body.innerText||'').slice(0,n)", n)


def shot(page, name):
    path = PROOF / f"{name}.png"
    page.screenshot(path=str(path), full_page=False)
    print("SHOT", path.name, flush=True)
    return str(path)


def wait_ready(page, sec=60):
    end = time.time() + sec
    while time.time() < end:
        low = txt(page, 800).lower()
        if "launching" in low or "personalization" in low:
            time.sleep(1.2)
            continue
        return True
    return False


def accrued_signals(body: str) -> dict:
    low = body.lower()
    return {
        "accrued_interest": "accrued interest" in low,
        "accrual": "accrual" in low and "interest" in low,
        "menu_hit": bool(re.search(r"accrued\s+interest", low)),
        "interest_accrued": "interest accrued" in low,
        "no_data": "no data" in low,
    }


def try_click(page, label, timeout=4500):
    try:
        page.get_by_text(label, exact=False).first.click(timeout=timeout)
        time.sleep(1.4)
        wait_ready(page)
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print("click fail", label, str(e)[:100], flush=True)
        return False


def login(page, email, password):
    print("WATCH: login — Alt-Tab to Chrome for Testing", flush=True)
    page.goto(ENTRY, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=120000)
    time.sleep(3)
    wait_ready(page)
    body = txt(page, 2000).lower()
    if "welcome" in body or "loan account management" in body:
        print("already logged in", flush=True)
        return
    # Microsoft / FusionX login variants
    for sel in (
        'input[type="email"]',
        'input[name="loginfmt"]',
        "#i0116",
        'input[placeholder*="Email" i]',
        'input[type="text"]',
    ):
        try:
            loc = page.locator(sel).first
            if loc.count() and loc.is_visible(timeout=2000):
                loc.fill(email)
                print("WATCH: filled email (not printing)", flush=True)
                break
        except Exception:
            continue
    for btn in ("Next", "Sign in", "Continue", "Submit"):
        try:
            page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile(btn, re.I)).first.click(timeout=2500)
            time.sleep(2)
            break
        except Exception:
            continue
    time.sleep(2)
    for sel in ('input[type="password"]', "#i0118", 'input[name="passwd"]'):
        try:
            loc = page.locator(sel).first
            if loc.count() and loc.is_visible(timeout=3000):
                loc.fill(password)
                print("WATCH: password step", flush=True)
                break
        except Exception:
            continue
    for btn in ("Sign in", "Next", "Yes", "Submit", "Continue"):
        try:
            page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile(btn, re.I)).first.click(timeout=2500)
            time.sleep(2)
        except Exception:
            continue
    print("WATCH: post-login / MFA if any — complete in this window", flush=True)
    time.sleep(8)
    wait_ready(page, 90)


def main():
    email, password = load_creds()
    out: dict = {
        "story": "PF-59472",
        "clone_of": "PF-58379",
        "engine": "LIQA",
        "mode": "visible_headed",
    }
    hunts = []

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(
            headless=False,
            slow_mo=250,
            args=["--start-maximized"],
        )
        context = browser.new_context(no_viewport=True)
        page = context.new_page()
        page.set_default_timeout(15000)

        login(page, email, password)
        page.goto(ENTRY, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=90000)
        time.sleep(2)
        wait_ready(page)
        home = txt(page, 5000)
        out["home"] = {
            "proof": shot(page, "00-home"),
            "signals": accrued_signals(home),
            "snip": home[:900],
        }
        hunts.append({"where": "dashboard", **accrued_signals(home)})

        # Browser find Accrued
        try:
            page.keyboard.press("Control+f")
            time.sleep(0.4)
            page.keyboard.type("Accrued Interest", delay=40)
            time.sleep(1.2)
            out["find_bar"] = {"proof": shot(page, "01-find-accrued")}
            page.keyboard.press("Escape")
        except Exception as e:
            out["find_bar_err"] = str(e)[:120]

        for label in ("Loan Account Management", "Account Maintenance"):
            try_click(page, label)

        am = txt(page, 10000)
        out["am_menu"] = {
            "proof": shot(page, "10-am-expanded"),
            "signals": accrued_signals(am),
            "snip": am[:1200],
        }
        hunts.append({"where": "account_maintenance", **accrued_signals(am)})

        # Inquiry
        if try_click(page, "Inquiry") or try_click(page, "Account Inquiry"):
            time.sleep(2)
            wait_ready(page)
            inq = txt(page, 8000)
            out["inquiry"] = {
                "proof": shot(page, "20-inquiry"),
                "signals": accrued_signals(inq),
                "snip": inq[:1000],
            }
            hunts.append({"where": "inquiry", **accrued_signals(inq)})
            # try account search
            try:
                page.get_by_text("Search by Account", exact=False).first.click(timeout=4000)
                time.sleep(1)
                page.keyboard.type("0042250036", delay=50)
                time.sleep(1)
                out["inquiry_typed"] = {"proof": shot(page, "21-inquiry-typed")}
            except Exception as e:
                out["inquiry_typed_err"] = str(e)[:120]

        # Settings
        page.goto(ENTRY, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=90000)
        time.sleep(2)
        wait_ready(page)
        if try_click(page, "Settings"):
            time.sleep(2)
            wait_ready(page)
            settings = txt(page, 12000)
            out["settings"] = {
                "proof": shot(page, "30-settings"),
                "signals": accrued_signals(settings),
                "snip": settings[:1400],
            }
            hunts.append({"where": "settings", **accrued_signals(settings)})

        # Guessed routes
        for route, name in (
            ("/account-management/accrued-interest", "40-route-am-accrued"),
            ("/transaction-management/accrued-interest", "41-route-tm-accrued"),
            ("/account-management/inquiry", "42-route-inquiry"),
        ):
            try:
                page.goto(f"{BASE}{route}", wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
                time.sleep(2)
                wait_ready(page)
                body = txt(page, 8000)
                out[name] = {
                    "url": page.url,
                    "proof": shot(page, name),
                    "signals": accrued_signals(body),
                    "snip": body[:900],
                }
                hunts.append({"where": name, **accrued_signals(body), "url": page.url})
            except Exception as e:
                out[f"{name}_err"] = str(e)[:160]

        any_menu = any(h.get("menu_hit") or h.get("accrued_interest") for h in hunts)
        # Filter false positives: chrome-only pages mentioning word in JS dump is rare;
        # require clear Accrued Interest as feature label in body snips from menu/settings.
        feature_present = False
        for h in hunts:
            if h.get("where") in ("dashboard", "account_maintenance", "settings") and h.get(
                "menu_hit"
            ):
                feature_present = True
        # Route that actually rendered feature chrome
        for key in ("40-route-am-accrued", "41-route-tm-accrued"):
            node = out.get(key) or {}
            snip = (node.get("snip") or "").lower()
            if "accrued interest" in snip and "loan account management" in snip:
                # still may be SPA shell — check for form/table cues
                if any(
                    x in snip
                    for x in ("create new", "calculation", "gl", "batch", "process", "amount")
                ):
                    feature_present = True

        verdict = "FEATURE_REACHABLE" if feature_present else "N/A_KENYA_NO_MENU"
        out["hunts"] = hunts
        out["verdict"] = verdict
        out["any_text_hit"] = any_menu
        out["assert_na"] = {"proof": shot(page, "90-assert-final")}

        (PROOF / "execute-run.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print("VERDICT", verdict, flush=True)
        print("WATCH: keeping window open 45s", flush=True)
        time.sleep(45)
        browser.close()

    print("DONE PF-59472", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

                loc.fill(email)

        except Exception:

    if not filled_u:

    for sel in ('input[placeholder="Password"]', 'input[type="password"]'):
        try:
            loc = page.locator(sel).first
            if loc.is_visible(timeout=2500):
                loc.click()
                loc.fill("")
                loc.fill(password)
                break
        except Exception:
            continue

    hunts = []
    page.goto(ENTRY, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=90000)
    time.sleep(2)
    wait_ready(page)
    if on_login(page):
        out["blocked"] = "still_on_login"
        out["login_proof"] = shot(page, "99-still-login")
        return "LOGIN_BLOCKED"

    home = txt(page, 6000)
    out["home"] = {"proof": shot(page, "00-home-lending"), "signals": accrued_signals(home), "snip": home[:1000]}
    hunts.append({"where": "dashboard", **accrued_signals(home)})

    try:
        page.keyboard.press("Control+f")
        time.sleep(0.3)
        page.keyboard.type("Accrued Interest", delay=35)
        time.sleep(1)
        out["find"] = {"proof": shot(page, "01-find-accrued")}
        page.keyboard.press("Escape")
    except Exception:
        pass

    for label in ("Loan Account Management", "Account Maintenance"):
        try_click(page, label)
    am = txt(page, 12000)
    out["am"] = {"proof": shot(page, "10-am"), "signals": accrued_signals(am), "snip": am[:1400]}
    hunts.append({"where": "am", **accrued_signals(am)})

    if try_click(page, "Inquiry") or try_click(page, "Account Inquiry"):

        out["inquiry"] = {"proof": shot(page, "20-inquiry"), "signals": accrued_signals(inq), "snip": inq[:1000]}
        hunts.append({"where": "inquiry", **accrued_signals(inq)})

    page.goto(ENTRY, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=90000)
